item.title: Lee Jin-sook "sends support wreath to Baejae High School" despite apology plans (사과한다는데…이진숙 “배재고에 응원 화환” 인증샷)
item.description:
As Baejae High School baseball players who chanted slogans mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement during a high school baseball game prepare to visit Gwangju Jeil High School (Gwangju Ilgo) on the 6th to apologize, People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-sook announced on the 5th that she had sent a wreath with the message "Standing with Baejae High School students." (고교야구 경기 도중 5·18 민주화운동을 조롱하는 응원 구호를 외친 서울 배재고 야구부 선수들이 6일 광주제일고(광주일고)를 찾아 사과할 예정인 가운데, 이진숙 국민의힘 의원이 “배재고 학생들과 함께 합니다”라고 적힌 화환을 보냈다고 5일 밝혔다.)

Lee posted a photo of the wreath on Facebook that day, stating, "I sent a wreath to Baejae High School. The wreath ribbon bears the phrases, 'What does Starbucks have to do with May 18?' and 'I stand with Baejae High School students.'" (이 의원은 이날 페이스북에 화환 사진을 올리며 “배재고에 화환을 보냈다. 화환 리본에는 ‘스타벅스가 5·18과 무슨 관계가 있나’, ‘배재고 학생들과 함께 합니다’라는 글귀가 적혀 있다”고 밝혔다.)

"If Starbucks symbolizes an insult to May 18 and Gwangju, then Starbucks should no longer be allowed to operate," Lee argued. "If, based on the presumption of 'democratic forces,' the chant 'Let's go to Starbucks' is conclusively deemed an insult to the Gwangju May 18 Uprising and Baejae High School baseball players are disciplined, then they are starting to 'handcuff thought.'" (이 의원은 “만약 스타벅스가 5·18과 광주에 대한 모욕을 상징한다면, 스타벅스는 더 이상 영업을 해서는 안 될 것”이라며 “‘민주세력’의 추정으로 ‘스타벅스 가야지’가 광주 5·18 모욕이라고 단정하고 배재고 야구부 학생들을 징계한다면, 그들은 ‘생각에 수갑을 채우는 짓’을 시작하는 것”이라고 주장했다.)

"Before I was automatically dismissed (effectively fired) from my position as chairman of the Korea Communications Commission by the administration, countless citizens sent wreaths to the Gwacheon KCC headquarters to encourage me," Lee added. "I also sent a wreath to give some strength to Baejae High School students, who might be terrified. They are the future generation, the key figures who will safeguard liberal democracy." (이 의원은 “제가 정권에 의해 (방송통신위원장에서) 자동면직(사실상 해직)되기 전, 수많은 시민들이 과천 방통위 청사 주변에 화환을 보내 격려를 해주셨다”며 “저도 공포에 질려있을지도 모를 배재고 학생들에게 조금이나마 힘을 주고 싶어서 화환을 보냈다. 그들이 미래 세대, 자유민주주의를 지켜낼 주역들이다”라고 덧붙였다.)

The incident erupted during the latter part of a baseball game at the 81st Blue Dragon National High School Baseball Tournament on the 29th of last month, when Baejae High School players repeatedly chanted, "Let's go, let's go, let's go to Starbucks," accompanied by rhythmic movements in the dugout, directed at Gwangju Ilgo players. Some students also loudly shouted "Tank Day." The chant was perceived as a "mocking cheer," reminiscent of recent controversy when Starbucks Korea used the promotional phrase "Tank Day" around the anniversary of the May 18 Democratization Movement. (이번 사건은 지난달 29일 제81회 청룡기 전국고교야구대회 경기 후반 배재고 선수들이 더그아웃(선수 대기석)에서 광주일고 선수들을 향해 “가야지, 가야지, 스타벅스 가야지”라는 구호를 율동과 함께 반복하면서 불거졌다. 일부 학생은 “탱크데이”라고 크게 외쳤다. 해당 구호는 최근 스타벅스코리아가 5·18 민주화운동 기념일을 전후해 ‘탱크데이’라는 홍보로 물의를 빚은 일을 연상케 하면서 ‘조롱 응원’으로 인식됐다.)

As criticism grew, the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA) on the 1st handed down a severe penalty to the Baejae High School baseball team, banning them from national competitions for six months. The decision was based on actions that violated the spirit of sports and disrupted stadium order, prompting the leadership of the People Power Party to uniformly criticize the measure as "excessive." (비판이 커지자 지난 1일 대한야구소프트볼협회(KBSA)는 배재고 야구부에 6개월 전국대회 출전 정지의 중징계를 내렸다. 스포츠 정신에 반하고 경기장 질서를 문란하게 한 행위라는 판단인데 이를 두고 국민의힘 지도부는 “과도한 조치”라고 일제히 비판한 바 있다.)

As the incident escalated into a political factional confrontation, both condolence wreaths and support wreaths were placed in front of Baejae High School simultaneously. Hundreds of civil complaints were filed, and the Gangdong-gu Office had to remove the wreaths on multiple occasions. (해당 사건이 정치적 진영 대결로 번지면서 배재고 앞에는 근조 화환과 응원 화환이 동시에 놓였다. 민원 수백 건이 제기됐고 강동구청은 여러 차례에 걸쳐 화환을 철거해야 했다.)

Seoul Superintendent of Education Jeong Keun-sik posted on Facebook on the 2nd, stating, "As the superintendent responsible for Seoul education, I bow my head and offer a deep apology to the student-athletes, parents, and alumni of Gwangju Jeil High School, and to the citizens of Gwangju and all Koreans who hold this historical pain in their hearts." The following day, Gwangju Ilgo announced that on the afternoon of the 6th, approximately 80 individuals, including Baejae High School baseball players, coaches, parents, and faculty, would visit to apologize. The baseball players, coaches, parents, and faculty from both schools plan to hold a 30-minute session of apology and reconciliation at the Gwangju Ilgo auditorium, followed by a joint visit to the National May 18 Memorial Cemetery in Gwangju. (정근식 서울시교육감은 지난 2일 페이스북에 글을 올려 “서울교육을 책임지는 교육감으로서 광주제일고등학교 학생선수와 학부모, 동문 여러분, 그리고 역사적 아픔을 간직한 광주시민과 국민 여러분께 고개 숙여 깊이 사과드린다”고 밝혔다. 다음날 광주일고는 6일 오후 배재고 야구부 학생 선수와 지도자, 학부모, 교직원 등 80여명의 사과 방문을 받기로 했다고 밝혔다. 두 학교의 야구부 학생들과 지도자, 학부모 교직원 등은 함께 광주일고 강당에서 30분가량 사과와 화해의 시간을 가진 뒤 국립 5·18민주묘지를 함께 참배할 계획이다.)

Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (이유진 기자 yjlee@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik: "Proposing New Future Response Fund with Additional Semiconductor Tax Revenue" (강훈식 “반도체 추가 세수로 미래대응기금 신설 추진”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik stated on the 5th, "The Lee Jae-myung administration intends to promote the establishment of a Future Response Fund to utilize additional tax revenue as investment resources for future generations," adding, "I ask for cooperation between the party and government so that it can be implemented swiftly." <<> Chief Kang made these remarks while attending the 9th High-Level Party-Government Consultative Meeting held that afternoon at the Prime Minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul. <<> Chief Kang said, "The creation of the Future Response Fund will be the cornerstone for realizing an irreplaceable Republic of Korea," and "By forming the fund with additional tax revenue, we aim to make bold investments in Korea's future, including supporting three mega projects to create future growth engines, addressing K-shaped polarization, and providing housing, startup, and job support for the 2030 generation." <<> Reporter Jung Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 “이재명 정부는 추가 세수를 미래 세대를 위한 투자 재원으로 활용하기 위해 미래대응기금 신설을 추진하고자 한다”며 “속도감 있게 추진될 수 있도록 당정의 협력을 당부드린다”고 5일 밝혔다.)

item.title: Former Secretary Shin Dong-ho: "Jung Cheong-rae also turned down a minister position in Lee Jae-myung's government" (신동호 전 비서관 “정청래, 이재명 정부 장관 제안도 거절”)
item.description:
Shin Dong-ho, a former speech secretary at the Moon Jae-in administration's Blue House, said on the 5th regarding former Democratic Party of Korea leader Jung Cheong-rae: "I understand that he received an offer to become a minister during the Moon Jae-in administration, and also recently received an offer from the (Lee Jae-myung) government, but he turned it down." Former Secretary Shin was also in charge of handling messages for former leader Jung. <<> Former Secretary Shin appeared on the YouTube program 'Tak Hyun-min's The Beautiful,' hosted by former Blue House protocol secretary Tak Hyun-min, and made these remarks while referencing former President Kim Dae-jung's political trajectory, noting that former leader Jung had never held an appointed position. <<> He said, "I'm not sure if it's comparable (to former President Kim), but since former leader Jung is my friend, I'll say this with some bias. Former leader Jung has never held an appointed position in his life." He added, "Before becoming a lawmaker for the first time in early 2004, he said, 'Even if I go into politics, I won't take appointed positions.' Even in terms of doing what he wants or contributing to the success of the Lee Jae-myung government, there's a way to help as a minister, but he clearly prefers to help politically." <<> He continued, "Former leader Jung is thinking about how the public evaluates him, and he has an attitude where he feels no need to flatter anyone with power or authority. I think those aspects need to be re-evaluated." <<> Ha Eo-young, Reporter haha@hani.co.kr (신동호 전 문재인 정부 청와대 연설비서관이 5일 정청래 더불어민주당 전 대표에 대해 “문재인 정부 때도 장관 제안을 받았고, 최근 (이재명) 정부에서도 장관 제안을 받은 것으로 알고 있다”며 “(정 전 대표가) 그걸 거절한 것”이라고 말했다. 신 전 비서관은 정 전 대표 메시지 담당을 맡기도 했다.)

item.title: South Korean Government to Skip Khamenei's Funeral…Ambassador's Attendance Plan Falls Through (한국 정부 하메네이 장례식 불참…대사 참석 추진했으나 무산)
item.description:
As the six-day funeral schedule for former Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei began in Tehran, Iran, on the 4th (local time), it has been confirmed that the South Korean government will officially not attend. The government had initially planned for Kim Joon-pyo, South Korea's ambassador to Iran, to participate. However, the attendance fell through after Iran notified that it would not accept the ambassador's presence at the funeral. (이란 테헤란에서 엿새간 열리는 알리 하메네이 전 이란 최고지도자의 장례식 일정이 4일(현지시각) 시작된 가운데 한국 정부는 공식 불참하는 것으로 파악됐다. 정부는 애초 김준표 주이란 한국대사의 참석을 추진했으나, 이란 측에서 대사의 장례식 참석은 받지 않는다고 통보해오면서 참석이 무산됐다.)

A foreign ministry official said on the 5th, "The South Korean ambassador to Iran intended to attend, but Iran asked for understanding, citing 'technical reasons' and saying that diplomatic missions would find it difficult to attend the funeral." It appears that the Iranian government is only accepting condolences from high-level delegations sent from other countries' home governments, not from ambassador-level officials. Iran's semi-official Tasnim News Agency also reported on the 3rd that "among at least 13 countries that withdrew from attending the funeral, some deployed their diplomats stationed in Tehran as substitutes to attend the event, but Iran did not accept this." Japan is also known to be absent from the funeral for reasons similar to South Korea's. (5일 외교부 관계자는 “주이란 한국대사가 참석하려고 했지만, 이란 쪽이 ‘기술적 이유’라며 외교단은 장례식 참석이 어렵다고 양해를 구해왔다”고 말했다. 이란 정부가 본국에서 파견되는 고위 대표단의 조문만 받고, 대사급 인사의 조문은 받지 않기로 한 것으로 보인다. 3일 이란 반관영 타스님통신도 “장례식 참석을 철회한 최소 13개 국가 중 일부는 행사 참석을 위해 테헤란 주재 자국 외교관을 대신 내세웠으나, 이란 측이 이를 받아들이지 않았다”고 보도했다. 일본도 한국과 비슷한 이유로 이번 장례식에 참석하지 않는 것으로 알려졌다.)

The government has worked to manage its diplomatic relations with Iran smoothly, maintaining its embassy even during air raids after the outbreak of the U.S.-Iran war. However, there is also speculation that the government may have adjusted the level of condolences to the local ambassador level to avoid causing unnecessary misunderstandings with the U.S. by attending the funeral. A foreign ministry official stated, "The U.S. did not ask us not to attend the funeral." (정부는 미국-이란 전쟁 발발 이후 공습 속에서도 대사관을 유지하는 등 이란과의 외교 관계를 원만하게 관리하기 위해 노력해왔다. 다만 장례식 참석으로 미국에 불필요한 오해를 불러일으키지 않도록 현지 대사급으로 조문 수위를 조절했을 가능성도 제기된다. 외교부 관계자는 “미국이 우리에게 장례식 참석을 하지 말라고 요청한 것은 없다”고 말했다.)

At this funeral, China sent a delegation led by He Wei, Vice Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, to offer condolences, while Russia was represented by Dmitry Medvedev, Deputy Chairman of the Russian Security Council. Other countries such as Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey also sent government delegations. In contrast, major Western countries are known to have uniformly declined to attend. Before the funeral schedule, Iran's foreign ministry had stated that countries supporting the U.S.-Israel airstrikes and European governments would not be invited. (이번 장례식에 중국은 허웨이 전국인민대표대회(전인대) 상무위원회 부위원장이 대표단을 이끌고 조문했고, 러시아에선 드미트리 메드베데프 러시아 국가안보회의 부의장이 참석했다. 이밖에 파키스탄, 사우디아라비아, 튀르키예 등도 정부 대표단을 보냈다. 반면 서방 주요국은 일제히 불참한 것으로 알려졌다. 이란 외무부는 장례 일정에 앞서 미·이스라엘 공습을 지지한 국가와 유럽국가의 정부는 초청하지 않을 것이라고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Byung-do: “Considering legislation to shorten fast-track from 330 days to 75 days” (한병도 “330일 소요 패스트트랙, 75일로 단축 입법 검토”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, announced on the 5th that he will submit a "Special Investigation Bill for the National Election Commission" to the National Assembly this week to investigate the ballot shortage incident and push for a special counsel probe. (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표가 이번주 투표용지 부족 사태를 규명할 ‘중앙선거관리위원회 특검법’을 국회에 제출해 특검 추진에 나서겠다고 5일 밝혔다.)

Floor Leader Han said on Facebook that day, "The Democratic Party will submit the Special Investigation Bill for the National Election Commission this week. We will include in the scope of the investigation the circumstances behind the reduced volume of ballot paper printing, the omission and delay in reporting to the command on election day, and the corruption and incompetence within the Election Commission." Regarding the People Power Party's claim that the Democratic Party should be excluded from the special counsel recommendation process, Floor Leader Han dismissed it, saying, "It is a strategical agitation not worth a second thought and is nonsense," adding, "Considering the uniqueness of the Election Commission, such as independence and impartiality, recommendations from third parties like the Korean Bar Association would be more realistic and fair." A leadership official explained, "Typically, the ruling and opposition parties, along with a third party, recommend and decide on the special counsel. This is a proposal that there could be cases where a third party makes the recommendation." <<> Meanwhile, at a high-level ruling party-government council held at the Prime Minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong, Seoul, Floor Leader Han said, "To create a working National Assembly, we need to improve the system," and stated, "We are considering legislation to shorten the fast-track (expedited processing items), which currently takes 330 days, to 75 days, and will strengthen the requirements for filibusters (unlimited debate)." <<> Although the July extraordinary session of the National Assembly opens on the 6th, a confrontation between the ruling and opposition parties over the formation of the assembly is expected to continue with a hardline stance. <<> Go Han-sol Reporter sol@hani.co.kr Jung Hye-min Reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (한 원내대표는 이날 페이스북을 통해 “민주당은 이번주, 선관위 특검법을 제출하겠다. 투표용지 인쇄 물량 축소 경위, 선거일 지휘부 보고 누락 및 지연, 선관위 내부 부패와 무능까지 수사 대상에 포함하겠다”고 말했다. 특검 추천 과정에서 민주당을 배제해야 한다는 국민의힘 주장에 대해 한 원내대표는 “일고의 가치도 없는 정략적 선동이자 어불성설”이라고 선을 그으며 “독립성과 중립성이라는 선관위의 특수성을 고려해 대한변호사협회 등 제3자 추천이 더 현실적이고 공정할 것”이라고 덧붙였다. 원내지도부 관계자는 “통상 여야, 제3자가 추천해서 (특검을) 그중에 결정하지 않나. 제3자가 추천하는 경우의 수도 있다는 제안”이라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok to Announce Party Leadership Bid in Gwangju Tomorrow... Kicking Off the Race for Party Leadership (김민석, 내일 광주서 당대표 출마선언…당권 경쟁 스타트 끊는다)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok will declare his candidacy for the party leadership in the August 17 Democratic Party of Korea National Convention in Gwangju on the 6th. With other contenders for party leadership, including former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae and lawmaker Song Young-gil, expected to announce their bids as well, the stage is set for a three-way race in the Democratic Party's national convention. <<> Kim's camp announced through a media notice on the 5th that he will pay respects at the National 5·18 Democratic Cemetery in Buk-gu, Gwangju at 9 a.m. on the 6th, followed by a declaration of his candidacy for the party leadership election at 10 a.m. at Jeonil Building 245, which still bears the scars of helicopter gunfire by martial law forces during the 5·18 Democratization Movement. Kim will then move to Seoul for an additional press conference at 2:10 p.m. at the National Assembly Communication Center. This marks his return to the party just six days after resigning as Prime Minister on the 30th of last month, and it is the first leadership candidacy announcement among all contenders. Initially, Kim had planned to declare his candidacy at the Gwangju military airfield—mentioned as a target site for the Honam mega-project—to emphasize his image of supporting stable state affairs, but changed the venue due to heavy rain forecasts. <<> Kim’s early move to announce his candidacy, reportedly backed by President Lee Jae-myung, appears aimed at seizing an early advantage in the race. Kim chose Honam, a key battleground in the national convention where one-third of the party's paid members are concentrated, as the location for his announcement. A lawmaker close to Kim stated, "Gwangju is a symbol of Honam public sentiment and also Kim's political roots, which this move seeks to highlight." <<> In his candidacy announcement, Kim is expected to emphasize his role as the 'first Prime Minister of the Lee Jae-myung administration,' underscoring his deep understanding of the President's national agenda. He plans to hold four debates on topics including supporting the success of the Lee administration's 'three mega-projects,' a Democratic Party for the 2030 generation and youth, a grand unity based on integration, solidarity, and expansion, and a party centered on member sovereignty and AI (artificial intelligence). <<> Meanwhile, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae visited the grave of former President Roh Moo-hyun at Bongha Village in South Gyeongsang Province on the same day. Highlighting himself as a 'Roh Moo-hyun kid,' he posted a photo of a guestbook message saying, 'President Roh, I miss you dearly,' and wrote, "I asked President Roh about his dreams: prosecutorial reform, the completion of the one-person-one-vote system, the unfinished integration and solidarity of the democratic camp, and a heartfelt commitment to the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." item.title: ‘Mass Disciplinary Action’ on the Horizon? People Power Party to Reactivate Ethics Committee Tomorrow (‘무더기 표적 징계’ 나오나…국힘, 내일 윤리위 재가동)
item.description:
Ahead of the reactivation of the People Power Party’s Central Ethics Committee, tensions within the party are at an all-time high, with speculation rising that a ‘mass disciplinary action’ may become a reality following the decision to discipline Representative Jang Dong-hyuk for his breach of party rules. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위원회 재가동을 앞두고 장동혁 대표의 해당 행위 징계 방침에 따라 ‘무더기 징계’가 현실화되는 것 아니냐는 관측이 나오며 당내 긴장감이 최고조에 달하고 있다.)

The People Power Party’s Central Ethics Committee will hold a plenary session on the afternoon of the 6th to deliberate disciplinary cases. Approximately 40 disciplinary requests have been submitted to the Ethics Committee. Among the top targets for discipline are pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmakers, including Kim Ye-ji, Ahn Sang-hoon, Jin Jong-oh, Jeong Seong-guk, Bae Hyun-jin, Woo Jae-joon, Park Jeong-hoon, and Han Ji-a, who assisted Representative Han Dong-hoon’s campaign in the June 3 by-election for Busan’s Buk-gu district, which he won as an independent. Disciplinary requests for members of the ‘Alternatives and Future’ group, who have openly called for Representative Jang’s resignation, have also been received. (국민의힘 중앙윤리위는 6일 오후 전체회의를 열어 징계 안건을 심의한다. 윤리위에 접수된 징계 요청서는 40여건 정도로 알려졌다. 징계 대상 1순위로는 6·3 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 무소속으로 당선된 한동훈 의원의 선거운동을 도운 김예지·안상훈·진종오·정성국·배현진·우재준·박정훈·한지아 등 친한동훈계 의원들이 꼽힌다. 장 대표의 사퇴를 공개적으로 촉구해온 ‘대안과 미래’ 소속 의원들의 징계 요청서도 접수된 상태다.)

In a YouTube broadcast last month, Representative Jang named lawmakers Kim Yong-tae, Kim Jae-seop, and Woo Jae-joon as “individuals attacking the leadership,” sparking speculation that they may face discipline. However, a party leadership official told *The Hankyoreh* on the 5th, “This is a procedure to restore party principles, not simply to punish people for criticizing the party leader.” Nevertheless, five-term lawmaker Yoon Sang-hyun expressed concern, stating to reporters, “If we apply legal and ethical standards to politics, politics cannot stand on its own.” (장 대표는 지난달 유튜브 방송에서 “지도부를 공격하는 인사들”로 김용태·김재섭·우재준 의원의 실명을 거론해 이들이 징계 대상이 아니냐는 관측이 나오지만, 당 지도부 관계자는 5일 한겨레에 “당 원칙을 바로 세우기 위한 절차로, 단순히 당대표를 비판한다는 이유로 징계하겠다는 게 아니다”라고 했다. 그러나 5선 윤상현 의원은 이날 기자들과 만나 “정치를 가지고 법·윤리의 잣대를 들이대면 정치가 바로 설 수 없다”고 우려했다.)

Ahead of the disciplinary actions, the conflict between the pro-leadership faction and the pro-Han faction has even escalated into a spat over Representative Han’s visit to offer condolences to Representative Jang’s family for a bereavement. After media reports revealed that Representative Han visited the mourning hall for Representative Jang’s family on the evening of the 2nd, the pro-leadership faction accused Han of ‘media play.’ Joo Hyun-chul, the deputy spokesperson for foreign affairs, wrote on Facebook the previous day, “(Representative Han) barged in without coordination with the bereaved family and left in just 10 minutes like an uninvited guest. It wasn’t a condolence, but a thoroughly calculated, shallow political act.” In response, former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk of the pro-Han faction retorted, “How can it be sane to criticize someone for coming to offer condolences?” (징계를 앞두고 당권파와 친한계의 갈등은 한 의원의 장 대표 가족상 조문을 두고 감정싸움으로도 번졌다. 한 의원이 지난 2일 밤 장 대표의 가족상 빈소를 찾은 사실이 언론 보도로 알려진 뒤 당권파는 이를 한 의원의 ‘언론플레이’라고 반발했다. 주현철 외신대변인은 전날 페이스북에 “(한 의원은 유족과) 조율 없이 들이닥쳐 고작 10분 만에 사라진 불청객”이라며 “애도가 아닌 철저히 계산된 얄팍한 정치 행위”라고 했다. 이에 친한계 김종혁 전 최고위원은 “왜 문상 왔냐고 비난하는 게 제정신이냐”고 했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Party, Government, and Presidential Office to Create 'Future Response Fund' with Additional Semiconductor Tax Revenue (당·정·청, 반도체 추가 세수로 ‘미래대응기금’ 만든다)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea, the government, and the presidential office agreed on the 5th to push for the creation of a Future Response Fund that would use additional tax revenue from the semiconductor industry boom as investment resources for future generations. (더불어민주당과 정부, 청와대가 5일 반도체 산업 호황에 따른 추가 세수를 미래 세대를 위한 투자 재원으로 활용하는 미래대응기금 신설을 추진하기로 했다.)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said in his opening remarks at the 9th high-level party-government-government council meeting held at the Prime Minister's official residence in Samcheong-dong, Seoul, that "the Lee Jae-myung administration intends to pursue the establishment of a Future Response Fund to use additional tax revenue as investment resources for future generations." He added, "By creating a fund with this additional tax revenue, we aim to make bold investments in Korea's future, including creating future growth engines by supporting three mega projects, addressing K-shaped polarization, and providing housing, startup, and job support for the 2030 youth generation." After the meeting, Democratic Party Senior Spokesperson Kang Joon-hyun also stated, "We sympathized with the government's position to use the additional tax revenue for future generations, Korea's growth engines, and addressing polarization. The party, government, and presidential office will work closely together." (강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 서울 삼청동 국무총리 공관에서 열린 제9차 고위당정협의회 머리발언에서 “이재명 정부는 추가 세수를 미래 세대를 위한 투자 재원으로 활용하기 위해 미래대응기금 신설을 추진하고자 한다”며 “추가 세수로 기금을 조성해 3대 메가프로젝트 지원을 포함한 미래 성장 동력 창출, 케이(K)자형 양극화 대응, 2030 청년을 위한 주거, 창업, 일자리 지원 등 대한민국의 미래에 과감한 투자를 하고자 한다”고 말했다. 회의 뒤 강준현 민주당 수석대변인도 “추가 세수를 미래 세대와 대한민국 성장 동력, 양극화 대응 등에 사용하겠다는 정부의 입장에 공감했다. 당·정·청이 긴밀히 협력해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

The scale of additional tax revenue over the next several years is expected to reach at least tens of trillions of won. (향후 수년간 추가 세수 규모는 최소 수십조원에 달할 것으로 보인다.)

Furthermore, the party, government, and presidential office decided to focus national capabilities on promoting the 'three mega projects' during the meeting. Senior Spokesperson Kang said, "We decided to provide full support for electricity, sites, and permits to ensure no disruptions occur in the construction of semiconductor factories and AI data centers. The party decided to launch a task force (TF) to support the three mega projects for this purpose." (아울러 당·정·청은 회의에서 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’ 추진에 국가적 역량을 집중하기로 했다. 강 수석대변인은 “반도체 공장과 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 구축에 차질이 발생하지 않도록 전력, 부지, 인허가 등을 전폭 지원하기로 했다. 당은 이를 위해 3대 메가프로젝트 지원 티에프(TF)를 출범하기로 했다”고 말했다.)

The party, government, and presidential office also agreed to select priority bills for the third quarter and exert all efforts for timely legislation, including quickly adjusting bills with no disagreements between ministries. (당·정·청은 또 3분기 중점 추진 법안을 선정하고, 부처 간 이견이 없는 법안은 신속 조정하는 등 적기 입법을 위해 총력을 다하기로 했다.)

Reporter Ko Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr (고한솔 기자 sol@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "May 18 Has Become a Sanctuary, Like North Korea"... Calls for Resignation Amidst Blue House Warning (이병태 “5·18 성역 돼, 북한 모습”…청와대 경고 속, 사퇴론 분출)
item.description:
Controversy continues over Lee Byung-tae, vice chairman of the president's direct Regulatory Rationalization Committee, who claimed that "May 18 has become a sanctuary" in reference to the heavy disciplinary action against Baejae High School's baseball team for regional disparagement cheers. There are growing calls within the ruling camp for his resignation, with critics noting that the vice chairman's, who holds a cabinet-level position, provocative actions are burdening President Lee Jae-myung's state affairs as they push for unity and pragmatism. (지역 비하 응원으로 인한 배재고등학교 야구부 중징계를 두고 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에 대한 여권 내 사퇴 요구가 나오는 등 논란이 계속되고 있다. 총리급인 이 부위원장의 돌출 행보가 통합·실용 인사를 내세운 이재명 대통령의 국정 운영에 부담을 주고 있다는 지적이 나온다.)

Kim Nam-jun, a Democratic Party lawmaker and former Blue House spokesperson, wrote on Facebook on the 5th: "The remarks of a free citizen and those of a public official holding a responsible position in a state institution can never carry the same weight. He should voluntarily resign." Fellow Democratic Party lawmaker Choi Min-hee also wrote on Facebook: "Vice Chairman Lee does not fit with the Lee Jae-myung administration. Resign immediately." Park Byung-eon, senior spokesperson of the Fatherland Innovation Party, also issued a statement urging his voluntary resignation, saying, "Vice Chairman Lee's remarks exceed what our society can tolerate for the sake of integrated governance." (청와대 대변인을 지낸 김남준 더불어민주당 의원은 5일 페이스북에 “자유로운 시민으로서의 발언과 국가기관의 책임 있는 직책을 맡은 공직자의 발언은 결코 같은 무게일 수 없다”며 “자진 사퇴해야 한다”고 말했다. 같은당 최민희 의원도 페이스북에 “이 부위원장은 이재명 정부와 안 어울린다. 즉시 사퇴하시라”고 썼다. 박병언 조국혁신당 선임대변인도 논평을 통해 “이 부위원장의 발언은 우리 사회가 통합적 운영을 위해 용인할 수 있는 수준을 넘어섰다”며 자진 사퇴를 촉구했다.)

On the 2nd, Vice Chairman Lee, a cabinet-level official, wrote on Facebook regarding the Baejae High School baseball team, which was disciplined for a 'Starbucks cheer song' mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement: "May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land" and "It's like North Korea." Although he deleted the post after controversy erupted, on the 4th, Vice Chairman Lee reaffirmed his stance on Facebook, stating: "The core of my opinion is 'freedom of expression. Shouting 'Long live Kim Il-sung' in the middle of Seoul should be allowed. That's a basic right." In response, the Blue House stated the same day: "As a person in a responsible position within a government-affiliated organization, this was inappropriate conduct. We have issued a stern warning and strongly requested that such behavior not recur in the future." ( 총리급인 이 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에서 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’로 징계를 받은 배재고 야구부와 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 썼다. 논란이 일자 해당 글을 삭제했지만 이 부위원장은 지난 4일 페이스북에 “내 의견의 핵심은 ‘표현의 자유’다” “서울 한복판에서 김일성 만세를 외쳐도 허용되어야 한다. 그게 기본권”이라며 기존 입장을 고수했다. 이에 청와대는 같은 날 “정부 소속 기관의 책임 있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”이라며 “이에 엄중히 경고하고, 향후 재발 방지를 강력히 요청했다”고 밝혔다.)

Regarding Vice Chairman Lee's claims, criticism arises that hatred and mockery of the May 18 movement cannot be viewed as 'freedom of expression.' Hong Seong-su, a law professor at Sookmyung Women's University, said: "When influential political figures speak this way, it inevitably becomes a message defending actions like 'it's okay to do that kind of cheering.' It's very concerning." ( 이 부위원장의 주장과 관련해 5·18에 대한 혐오와 조롱을 ‘표현의 자유’로 볼 수 없다는 비판이 나온다. 홍성수 숙명여대 법학과 교수는 “정치적으로 영향력 있는 분들이 이렇게 이야기하면 ‘그런 응원을 해도 된다’는 식의 옹호 메시지가 될 수밖에 없다. 상당히 우려스럽다”고 말했다.)

Concerns are also emerging that Vice Chairman Lee, appointed in March under President Lee's policy of unity and pragmatic personnel, is publicly continuing such claims. Vice Chairman Lee, an honorary professor at the Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), is a conservative figure who served as head of the policy headquarters for Hong Joon-pyo's camp during last year's People Power Party presidential primary. In 2019, Vice Chairman Lee faced harsh criticism for calling the Moon Jae-in administration's minimum wage hike policy "senile" and describing the Sewol Ferry disaster as an "unfortunate traffic accident." ( 이 대통령의 통합·실용 인사 기조에 따라 지난 3월 규제합리화위 부위원장으로 임명된 그가 이러한 주장을 공개적으로 이어간 것에 대한 우려도 나온다. 한국과학기술원(KAIST) 명예교수인 이 부위원장은 지난해 국민의힘 대선 경선 당시 홍준표 후보 캠프 정책총괄본부장을 맡은 보수 출신 인사다. 이 부위원장은 2019년에도 당시 문재인 정부의 최저임금 인상 정책을 비판하며 “치매인가”라고 하고, 세월호 참사에 대해 “불행한 교통사고”라고 한 사실이 알려져 거센 비판을 받은 바 있다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Jun-hyuk pointed out: "President Lee Jae-myung appointed conservative figures for social unity, but instead, they are distorting the people's will and uttering reckless nonsense." Han Sang-hee, a professor at Konkuk University's Law School, said: "These are remarks that a public official should never make. Denigrating May 18, which forms the foundation of the Constitution's direction and ideological values, is an act of denying the Constitution itself and the values the Korean national community pursues." ( 김준혁 민주당 의원은 “​이재명 대통령께서 사회 통합 차원에서 보수 인사를 중용했더니 오히려 국민의 뜻을 왜곡하며 망발을 일삼고 있다”고 지적했다. 한상희 건국대 법학전문대학원 교수는 “공직자로서는 해서는 안 되는 발언”이라며 “헌법의 지향이나 이념적인 가치의 밑바닥을 이루는 5·18을 폄하하는 발언을 하는 건 헌법 그 자체와 대한민국이라는 국가공동체의 지향 가치를 부정하는 행위”라고 했다.)

Jung Hye-min, Jang Na-rae, Ko Kyung-ju jhm@hani.co.kr (정혜민 장나래 고경주 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "Hate speech cannot be punished unless it leads to action... We must develop a spirit that doesn't get hurt" (이병태 “혐오 발언, 행동 않으면 처벌 못 해…상처받지 않는 심지 키워야”)
item.description:
Amid ongoing calls from within the ruling party for the resignation of Lee Byung-tae, Vice Chair of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Reform, over his claim that "the May 18 Gwangju Democratization Movement has become a sanctuary" in relation to the severe disciplinary action against Baejae High School's baseball team for regionally derogatory cheers, Vice Chair Lee has issued an explanation, stating, "This does not mean that freedom of expression comes without responsibility." (지역 비하 응원으로 인한 배재고등학교 야구부 중징계를 두고 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에 대한 여권 내 사퇴 요구가 이어지고 있는 가운데 이 부위원장이 “표현의 자유가 책임이 따르지 않는다는 말이 아니다”라며 해명에 나섰다.)

Vice Chair Lee made this statement on his Facebook page on the night of the 5th, saying, "The responsibility for reflection falls within the realm of social condemnation, not legal discipline." He added, "The correct way to respond to offensive language is not through the legal blade of regulation and punishment. In life, we must learn to consider others, but we must also cultivate a spirit that is not wounded by the words of others." (이 부위원장은 5일 밤 자신의 페이스북에 “성찰의 책임은 사회적 규탄의 영역이지, 법적 징계의 영역이 아니라는 말”이라며 이같이 말했다. 그는 “불쾌한 언어에 대응하는 올바른 방법은 규제와 징계라는 법적 칼날이 아니다”며 “살아가면서 타인에 대한 배려도 배워야하지만 타인의 말에 상처받지 않는 심지도 키워야 한다”고 말했다.)

On the 2nd, Vice Chair Lee, a cabinet-level official, wrote on Facebook regarding the Baejae High baseball team, which was disciplined for a 'Starbucks cheer song' mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement, stating, "This land has made May 18 a sanctuary," and "It's like North Korea." As criticism of the post mounted, Vice Chair Lee reiterated on Facebook on the 4th, "The core of my opinion is 'freedom of expression,'" repeating his claim that the disciplinary action was unjust. (총리급인 이 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에서 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’로 징계를 받은 배재고 야구부와 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 썼다. 이후 해당 글에 대한 비판이 이어지자 이 부위원장은 지난 4일 페이스북에 “내 의견의 핵심은 ‘표현의 자유’다”라며 징계가 부당하다는 주장을 반복했다.)

Below is the full text of Vice Chair Lee's post. (아래는 이 부위원장의 글 전문.)

[Dangerous Arguments About Freedom of Expression] ([표현의 자유에 대한 위험한 주장들])

It is disheartening that defending freedom of expression is being twisted into an insult to May 18, so I had intended to refrain from further comment. However, as some spread arguments criticizing both sides and suggesting potential restrictions on freedom of expression, I will clarify my understanding of this principle once again. (표현의 자유 옹호가 5.18 모욕으로 둔갑하는 상황이 절망적이라서 더 이상 언급을 하려고 하지 않았지만 일각의 양비론적 표현의 자유 제약 가능성의 주장들이 퍼지고 있어서 내가 이해하는 표현의 자유에 대해 다시 밝힌다.)

I usually enjoy reading the insightful writings of my Facebook friend, writer Oh Jin-young. (평소 나는 페친 오진영 작가님의 맛깔나는 글을 즐겨 읽는다.)

However, the following rebuttal regarding freedom of expression, which I inadvertently sparked, is an argument that effectively denies freedom of expression. (하지만 내가 촉발한 표현의 자유에 대한 아래 반론은 표현의 자유를 사실상 인정하지 않는 주장이다.)

This piece is grounded in John Stuart Mill's 'Harm Principle,' sharply distinguishing between the expression of universal ideas and collective insults or mockery directed at specific targets. (이글은 존 스튜어트 밀의 ‘해악의 원칙(Harm Principle)’을 근거로 삼아, 보편적 사상 표출과 특정 대상을 향한 집단적 모욕·조롱을 날카롭게 분리해 낸 글이다.)

But based on the essence of liberal philosophy, the perspective of legal philosophy, and precedents in modern democratic nations including the US, I will examine why the core premise of this article negates freedom of expression. (하지만 자유주의 철학의 본질과 법철학적 관점, 그리고 미국을 비롯한 현대 민주주의 국가의 판례 기준을 바탕으로 이 글의 핵심 전제가 왜 표현의 자유를 부정하는 지 살펴본다.)

( )

1. The Trap of Dichotomy in Adjudicating Freedom of Expression (1. 표현의 자유를 재단하는 이분법의 함정)

What is the truth according to Mill's harm principle and US precedents? (밀의 해악과 미국의 판례가 말하는 진실은 무엇인가?)

The original text clearly divides chants of "Long live Kim Il-sung" at Gwanghwamun and collective taunting slogans at baseball games using a dichotomy of 'self-regarding conduct' and 'other-regarding conduct,' justifying regulation of the latter. (원문은 광화문에서의 “김일성 만세”와 야구장에서의 집단적 조롱 구호를 ‘자기 관련 행위’와 ‘타인 관련 행위’라는 이분법으로 명쾌하게 나누어 후자에 대한 규제를 정당화한다.)

However, this logic not only arbitrarily interprets John Stuart Mill's philosophy but also commits a fatal error by overlooking the essential nature of freedom of expression and the development of modern democratic legal philosophy. (그러나 이 논리는 존 스튜어트 밀의 사상을 자의적으로 해석했을 뿐만 아니라, 표현의 자유가 가진 본질적 속성과 현대 민주주의 법철학의 발전 과정을 간과한 치명적인 오류를 범하고 있다.)

( )

(1). John Stuart Mill did not advocate for punishing 'the freedom to offend' or 'verbal attacks.' ((1). 존 스튜어트 밀은 ‘기분 나쁠 자유’나 ‘언어적 공격’의 처벌을 말하지 않았다.)

The original text cites Mill's seminal work "On Liberty," arguing that verbal attacks causing harm to others are subject to regulation. (원문은 밀의 명저 <자유론>을 인용하며, 타인에게 해악을 끼치는 언어적 공격은 규제 대상이라고 주장한다.)

But the 'Harm' Mill refers to does not mean causing subjective emotional distress, feelings of insult, or psychological injury in others. (하지만 밀이 말한 ‘해악(Harm)’은 타인의 주관적 감정이 상하거나, 모욕감을 느끼거나, 정신적 상처를 입는 것을 의미하지 않는다.)

The harm defined by Mill is limited to actions that directly infringe on another's legal rights or cause substantial physical damage. (밀이 정의한 해악은 타인의 법적 권리를 직접적으로 침해하거나 실질적인 물리적 손해를 입히는 행위에 국한된다.)

If all expressions that offend or hurt someone were defined as 'harm' and punished, every controversial expression in the world would be banned. Mill argued that even opinions the majority find extremely hateful and insulting should, unless they incite physical violence, be thoroughly guaranteed to allow the self-correcting power of truth to operate. (만약 누군가를 불쾌하게 만들고 상처를 주는 표현을 모두 ‘해악’으로 규정해 처벌한다면, 세상의 모든 논쟁적 표현은 금지될 것이다. 밀은 오히려 다수가 극도로 혐오하고 모욕적이라고 느끼는 의견이라 할지라도, 그것이 물리적 폭력을 선동하지 않는 한 철저히 보장되어야 진리의 자정 능력이 발휘된다고 보았다.)

To borrow writer Oh's expression, if Mill rose from his grave, he would be most angered that his philosophy is being used as a justification for 'regulating offensive language.' (오 작가의 표현을 빌려말하면 밀이 무덤에서 일어난다면, 자신의 철학이 ‘불쾌감을 주는 언어 규제’의 명분으로 쓰이는 것에 가장 먼저 분노했을 것이다.)

When we speak, it is impossible to accurately predict the other person's feelings. If we were to avoid speaking based on that premise, we would have little to say. Even the phrase "Have you eaten?" could be seen by someone as an insult, implying they are seen as incapable of feeding themselves. Feelings (emotions) are subjective, internal psychological states. (말을 할 때 우리는 상대의 기분을 정확히 예상하는 일은 불가능하다. 그것을 전제로 말을 하지 말라면 할말이 별로 없다. "밥 먹었니"라는 말에도 어떤 사람은 내가 밥도 못 먹고 다닐 무능한 사람으로 보면서 모욕한다고 생각할 수 있다. 기분(감정)은 객관적이지 않은 내면의 심리다.)

( )

(2) The dichotomy based on whether a target is identified cannot be established ((2) 대상을 지목했는가에 따른 이분법은 성립할 수 없다)

Writer Oh argues that attacks aimed at a specific target have clear victims and therefore cannot be protected under freedom of expression. (오 작가님은 특정 대상을 향한 공격에는 명백한 피해자가 존재하므로 표현의 자유로 보호할 수 없다고 한다.)

However, every utterance, whether it directly names someone or not, inevitably has a target within a given context. If we begin restricting freedom of expression based on whether a target is explicitly named, the marketplace of ideas completely collapses. (그러나 모든 말은 직접 거론하든 안 하든 맥락 속에서 반드시 상대를 갖기 마련이다. 대상을 명시했는지 여부로 표현의 자유를 제약하기 시작하면 사상의 자유 시장은 완전히 붕괴한다.)

Consider the chant "Long live Kim Il-sung" at Gwanghwamun, which Writer Oh condoned. This slogan does not target a specific individual, so is it harmless? Not at all. For countless displaced people and bereaved families who lost loved ones in the Korean War, and for victims of human rights abuses by the North Korean regime, the cry "Long live Kim Il-sung" is a more tearful verbal violence than any mockery, an act of trampling on the dignity of life. (오 작가가 용인한 광화문의 “김일성 만세”를 생각해보자. 이 구호는 특정인을 지목하지 않았으니 무해한가? 전혀 그렇지 않다. 6·25 전쟁으로 가족을 잃은 수많은 실향민과 유가족, 그리고 북한 정권에 의해 인권을 유린당한 피해자들에게 “김일성 만세”라는 외침은 그 어떤 조롱보다 피눈물이 나는 언어적 폭력이자 삶의 존엄을 짓밟는 행위다.)

They too could demand punishment, calling it "direct verbal violence against me." If freedom of expression is adjudicated based on subjective hurt and the target, eventually, no one can voice minority opinions that are socially unacceptable. (그들 역시 “나를 향한 직접적인 언어 폭력”이라며 처벌을 요구할 수 있다. 이처럼 주관적인 상처와 대상을 기준으로 표현의 자유를 재단하면, 결국 그 누구도 사회적으로 용인되지 않는 소수의견을 낼 수 없게 된다.)

( )

(3) Why modern democracies base punishment on 'actions,' not 'expressions' ((3) 현대 민주주의가 ‘표현’이 아닌 '행위'를 처벌 기준으로 삼는 이유)

The reason advanced democratic nations, including the US, do not hastily punish offensive or insulting expressions by law is clear. (미국을 비롯한 선진 민주주의 국가들이 혐오감이나 모욕감을 주는 표현을 법으로 성급히 처벌하지 않는 이유는 명확하다.)

Once we start punishing speech, state power becomes a dictatorial judge deciding what is 'legitimate speech' and what is 'punishable speech.' Therefore, modern legal philosophy imposes legal sanctions only when there is a specific 'action' or a 'clear and present danger,' not just 'expression.' (말을 처벌하기 시작하면 공권력이 무엇이 ‘정당한 말’이고 무엇이 ‘처벌받을 말’인지 결정하는 독재적 심판관이 되기 때문이다. 따라서 현대 법학은 오직 ‘표현’이 아닌 구체적인 ‘행위’와 ‘명백하고 현존하는 위험’이 발생할 때만 법적 제재를 가한다.)

Landmark US Supreme Court rulings prove this. (미국 대법원의 기념비적인 판결들이 이를 증명한다.)

Brandenburg v. Ohio (1969): Even though the white supremacist group KKK spewed extreme hate speech against Black people and Jews, the Supreme Court ruled it could not be punished unless it was "directed to inciting or producing imminent lawless action and is likely to incite or produce such action." (브란덴부르크 대 오하이오 사건 (1969년): 백인 우월주의 집단인 KKK가 흑인과 유대인을 향해 극단적인 혐오 발언을 쏟아냈음에도, 대법원은 이것이 “임박한 불법 행위를 선동하거나 발생시킬 가능성이 없는 한” 처벌할 수 없다고 판결했다.)

This is a landmark ruling establishing the principle that even hate speech directed at others cannot be punished unless it involves action or conduct. (이게 상대가 있는 혐오적 발언도 행동이나 행위가 아니면 처벌하지 않는 원칙의 기념비적 판결이다.)

National Socialist Party of America v. Skokie (1977): Even when neo-Nazi communists attempted to march displaying swastikas in a village populated by Holocaust survivors, the US court held that the march itself could not be banned, no matter how grotesque the expression and how terrible the pain it would cause the survivors. (내셔널 소셜리스트당 대 스코키 사건 (1977년): 유대인 학살(홀로코스트) 생존자들이 집단 거주하는 마을에서 네오나치 공산주의자들이 나치 문양을 들고 행진하려 했을 때도, 미국 법원은 그 표현이 아무리 기괴하고 유족들에게 끔찍한 고통을 줄지라도 행진 자체를 금지할 수 없다고 보았다.)

These rulings are not because American society agrees with the ideas of neo-Nazis or the KKK. It is because even if language is offensive and evil, as long as it does not lead to the specific act of 'physical violence,' the state's control of expression causes greater harm to the democratic system. (이 판결들은 미국 사회가 네오나치나 KKK의 사상에 동조해서가 아니다. 아무리 불쾌하고 사악한 언어일지라도, 그것이 '물리적 폭력'이라는 구체적 행위로 이어지지 않는 한, 국가가 표현을 통제하는 것이 민주주의 체제에 더 큰 해악을 끼친다는 점을 알기 때문이다.)

( )

(4) This does not mean that freedom of expression comes without responsibility. It means the responsibility for reflection falls within the realm of social condemnation, not legal discipline. ((4) 표현의 자유가 책임이 따르지 않는다는 말이 아니다. 성찰의 책임은 사회적 규탄의 영역이지, 법적 징계의 영역이 아니다라는 말이다.)

Repeating falsehoods carries the responsibility of moral condemnation and damage to one's reputation. (거짓을 반복하면 도덕적 비난과 자신의 명성에 해가 되는 책임이 따른다.)

But punishing lies gives state power the authority to judge what is false, creating the potential for totalitarianism. (하지만 거짓말을 처벌하면 거짓을 판결하는 권한을 공권력이 갖게되고 그것은 전체주의로 갈 가능성이 생긴다.)

To reiterate the above: if someone defrauds another of property or slanders them causing material loss, that is punishable; but a lie itself is not subject to punishment by state power. (위의 내용을 다시 확인하면 거짓으로 남의 재산을 갈취했거나 명예를 훼손해서 물질적 손실을 끼쳤으면 처벌 대상이지 거짓말 자체가 공귄력에 의한 처벌 대상이 아니라는 말이다.)

The taunting slogans echoing in the baseball stadium (if they were hate speech) are low-class acts that deserve to be criticized and morally condemned by a mature civil society. The argument that a true liberal should reflect so that their language does not cut into the dignity of others is ethically correct. (야구장에서 울려 퍼진 조롱 구호는 (만약 그것이 혐오 발언이었다면) 성숙한 시민사회에서 마땅히 비판받고 도덕적으로 규탄받아야 할 저급한 행위다. 진정한 자유주의자라면 나의 언어가 타인의 존엄을 베지 않도록 성찰해야 한다는 주장 역시 윤리적으로 옳다.)

If we punish mockery that offends others, someone must draw a line on whether "Let's go to Starbucks" is mockery and to what degree it is offensive. Can Writer Oh draw the line between mockery and satire? (타인에게 불쾌감을 준 조롱을 처벌한다면 “스벅 가자”가 조롱인지, 불쾌감의 정도가 얼마인지 누군가는 선을 그어야 한다. 오 작가님은 조롱과 풍자의 경계를 그을 수 있는가?)

Punishment based on subjective experience creates countless unjustly treated people. (주관적 경험을 근거로 처벌하면 억울한 사람들이 양산된다.)

But the moment we try to silence speech through state power or institutional discipline because one failed to uphold that 'responsibility for reflection,' liberalism meets its end. (그러나 그 '성찰의 책임'을 지키지 않았다고 해서 국가 권력이나 제도적 징계를 통해 말의 입을 막으려는 순간, 자유주의는 종말을 고한다.)

The correct way to respond to offensive language is not through the legal blade of regulation and discipline. (불쾌한 언어에 대응하는 올바른 방법은 규제와 징계라는 법적 칼날이 아니다.)

Making those slogans themselves shameful through greater criticism in the public sphere and social pressure from mature citizens—that is precisely the great self-correcting power of modern society that Mill dreamed of. (공론장 속에서 더 큰 비판과 성숙한 시민들의 사회적 압박을 통해 그 구호를 스스로 부끄럽게 만드는 것, 그것이 바로 밀이 꿈꾸었던 위대한 근대 사회의 자정 능력이다.)

This means that law should be the minimum of morality. (법은 도덕의 최소한이 되어야 한다는 것이 이 말이다.)

In establishing social order, there exist realms of moral self-regulation and heteronomous regulation by state power. Nothing is perfect, but we weigh the costs and benefits of choosing one method over another. (사회의 질서를 정립해 가는 방법은 도덕적 자율 규제와 공권력에 의한 타율 규제의 영역이 존재하는 것이다. 그 어떤 것도 완벽하지 않지만 어떤 방법을 선택했을 때 긍정과 부정의 대가를 저울질한다.)

Human history has concluded that it is advantageous for social development and safety to protect freedom of expression to the greatest extent possible. This is not because language is not offensive or violent. (인류 역사는 표현의 자유는 최대한 보호하는 것이 사회 발전과 안전에 유리하다는 결론을 낸 것이다. 언어가 타인에게 기분 나쁘고 폭력성이 없어서가 아니다.)

In life, we must learn to consider others, but we must also cultivate a spirit that is not wounded by the words of others. If we unintentionally hurt someone, we apologize; we accept apologies for slips of the tongue, shake hands, and part ways—that is how human society works. (우리는 살아가면서 타인에 대한 배려도 배워야하지만 타인의 말에 상처받지 않는 심지도 키워야 한다. 의도하지 않았으나 상처 받은 상대가 있으면 사과하고, 실언의 사과를 수용하고 악수하고 헤어지는 것이 사람 사는 세상이다.)

Writer Oh's article below clearly misunderstands the philosophy of John Stuart Mill. (오 작가의 아래 글은 스튜어드 밀의 철학을 분명하게 오해한 글이다.)

I do not wish to prolong this controversy, but rather to express concern that intellectuals in this country are taking an inaccurate, both-sides position on freedom of expression. (나는 이 논란을 계속하고자 하는 것이 아니라 이 땅의 지식인들이 표현의 자유에 대해 정확하지 않은 양비론적 입장을 취하는 것에 대해 우려를 전하고자 하는 것이다.)

item.title: Amid power shortage concerns, the presidential office and government fuel necessity of additional nuclear power plant construction (전력난 지적에 추가 원전 건설 필요성 불지피는 청와대·정부)
item.description:
The presidential office and government are increasingly mentioning the construction of additional nuclear power plants as a solution to ensure stable power supply for the southwestern semiconductor cluster and artificial intelligence (AI) data centers. (청와대와 정부에서 서남권 반도체 클러스터와 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터에 안정적 전력 공급을 위한 방안으로 원자력발전소 추가 건설 언급이 잇따라 나오고 있다.)

Cheong Wa Dae Policy Chief Kim Yong-beom emphasized the state's role in the era of the AI production revolution on Facebook on the 5th, writing, "In the age of AI, the state's role is to build power grids, develop industrial sites, and organize supply chains." He added, "Competitiveness in the AI era lies not in individual companies' competitiveness but in the competitiveness of the entire national production system." On the 2nd, Kim hinted at the possibility of constructing new nuclear power plants and expanding dams, stating, "Let's free up power and water." ( 김용범 청와대 정책실장은 5일 페이스북에 인공지능 생산혁명 시대의 국가의 구실을 강조하며 “인공지능 시대에 국가의 역할은 전력망을 구축하고, 산업부지를 조성하며, 공급망을 조직하는 것”이라고 적었다. 그는 “인공지능 시대의 경쟁력은 개별 기업의 경쟁력이 아니라 국가 전체 생산체계의 경쟁력”이라고 덧붙였다. 김 실장은 지난 2일 “전력과 용수를 풀자”며 신규 원전 건축과 댐 증축 가능성을 시사했다.)

Presidential Economic Growth Senior Secretary Ha Joon-kyung also said on the 4th regarding the mega-project power supply issue, "While it's certain that the renewable energy sector will be activated, for what cannot be fully covered, nuclear power plants may be necessary." Climate, Energy, and Environment Minister Kim Seong-hwan said on the 3rd, "We need to quickly review whether we should build additional nuclear plants. There is land to build two more units at the Hanbit nuclear plant in Yeonggwang, South Jeolla, and two more at the Saeul nuclear plant in Ulju, Ulsan, totaling four units." Earlier, on the 29th of last month, Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik responded to a question about the possibility of introducing additional nuclear plants by saying, "You can think of it as being included in the 12th Basic Plan for Power Supply and Demand (Electricity Plan)." The 12th Electricity Plan includes plans for how electricity will be produced and supplied by 2040. In April, the general committee for establishing the 12th Electricity Plan forecasted that power consumption in 2040 would be 657.6 to 694.1 TWh (terawatt-hours), with peak annual power demand reaching 131.8 to 138.2 GW (gigawatts). However, this forecast is before reflecting the three major mega-projects. <<> In response to the government's moves, climate and environmental groups have begun to push back. The "National Emergency Action to Block New Nuclear Power Plants," an alliance of anti-nuclear and environmental groups, stated, "The 12th Electricity Plan must not become a plan to expand supply to meet the power demand of specific industries and large corporations," and added, "If the government wants its past statements on addressing the climate crisis and energy transition to be credible, it should choose a path toward a society that can operate with less electricity and a safe, just transition to renewable energy." <<> Meanwhile, President Lee Jae-myung rebutted the People Power Party's claim that the announcement of the "three major mega-projects" on the 4th was aimed at boosting approval ratings, saying, "If it had been a political tool for approval rating management, we would have started it before the local elections." <<> Reporters Go Kyung-ju, Park Ki-yong, and Jo Hee-yeon goh@hani.co.kr ( 하준경 청와대 경제성장수석도 지난 4일 메가프로젝트 전력 공급 문제에 관해 “재생에너지 분야가 활성화될 것이 확실하지만 다 커버가 안 되는 것들은 원전이 필요할 수도 있을 것”이라고 말했다. 김성환 기후에너지환경부 장관도 지난 3일 “원전을 추가로 지어야 할지 빨리 검토해야 한다. 전남 영광 한빛 원전에 2기, 울산 울주 새울 원전에 2기 등 총 4기를 더 지을 땅이 있다”고 말했다. 앞서 강훈식 대통령 비서실장 역시 지난달 29일 원전 추가 도입 가능성에 대한 질문에 “12차 전력수급기본계획(전기본)에 내용이 들어갈 것으로 생각하면 된다”고 말한 바 있다. 12차 전기본엔 2040년까지 전력을 어떻게 생산하고 공급할지에 관한 계획이 담긴다. 지난 4월 12차 전기본 수립 총괄위원회는 2040년 전력소비량은 657.6~694.1TWh(테라와트시), 연중 최대 전력 수요는 131.8~138.2GW(기가와트)에 이를 것으로 전망했다. 다만 이 전망은 3대 메가프로젝트가 반영되기 전이다.)

item.title: Board of Audit and Inspection Launches Audit of Election Commission…Focusing on Ballot Paper Budget, Various Allowances, etc. (감사원, 선관위 감사 착수…투표지 예산·각종 수당 등 대상)
item.description:
The Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI) on the 6th began an audit in the accounting sector of the National Election Commission (NEC), which caused a shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections, investigating issues such as the signing of private contracts and suspicions of improper business trips. (감사원이 6·3지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 일으킨 선거관리위원회를 대상으로 수의계약 체결과 부정 출장 의혹 등에 대한 회계 분야 감사에 6일 착수했다.)

The BAI announced on the same day, "We will audit the central NEC, as well as the election commissions in Seoul, Gyeonggi, and Busan, along with their respective district, city, and county commissions, regarding the planning and execution of election-related budgets since 2022, as well as matters of significant public concern." (감사원은 이날 “중앙선관위와 서울·경기·부산 지역 선관위 및 관할 구·시·군 선관위를 대상으로 2022년 이후 선거 관련 예산 편성과 집행 실태, 국민적 의혹이 큰 사항 등을 감사할 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

The audit targets consist of 12 items across two areas: △ the process of planning and executing election-related budgets, and △ issues of public concern and compliance with previous BAI corrective orders. (감사 대상은 △선거 관련 예산 편성과 집행 과정 △국민 의혹과 감사원 처분 요구 등 2개 분야 12개 사항이다.)

First, the primary focus of the audit is on the planning and execution of the ballot paper printing budget and the related printing contracts. The audit plans to scrutinize the payment of various allowances, including attendance fees for election duties, document review allowances, management allowances, and incentive payments, as well as the purchase and management of election materials and the leasing of buildings. This comes after it was revealed that former Central NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak and other non-standing members received excessive allowances worth tens of millions of won, and that employees who had received false allowances over the past five years received only light disciplinary actions. Additionally, the audit will cover the operation of fair election support teams, the payment of daily wages for temporary workers, the management costs and allowances for overseas election management, and the estimation of election expenses and budget adjustments, including personnel costs. (우선, 투표용지 인쇄 예산 편성과 집행, 인쇄 계약 사항이 주요 감사 대상이다. 선거 업무 관련 출석 수당과 인건검토수당·관리수당·격려금 등 각종 수당 지급 실태와 선거 물품 구매·관리, 건물 임차 상황도 모두 살펴볼 계획이다. 노태악 전 중앙선관위원장 등 비상임 위원들이 억대 수당을 챙기고, 지난 5년 동안 허위 수당을 받은 직원들이 솜방망이 징계를 받은 데 그친 문제 등이 드러난 상황이다. 또, 공정선거지원단 운영과 기간제 근로자 일용임금 집행, 재외국민선거 관리경비와 수당 지급, 인건비 등 선거 경비소요 추계와 예산 조정 관련 사항도 감사 대상이다.)

Regarding public concerns, the issue of the NEC's private contract procurement is also included in the audit. The BAI will examine the process of calculating contract prices, suspicions of funneling work to specific entities, contract splitting, and whether there are special relationships between contract parties and the NEC. It will also look into the overseas business trips and travel expense payments of NEC officials, as well as the execution of operational expenses and overtime meal costs. The management of reimbursement claims for candidates whose elections were invalidated will also be audited. The NEC has failed to recover approximately 23.6 billion won from candidates who must return election expenses due to violations of election law. (국민 의혹과 관련해선, 선관위의 수의계약 체결 문제도 감사 대상에 포함됐다. 계약단가 산정 과정과 일감 몰아주기, 쪼개기 계약 의혹, 계약 당사자와 선관위의 특수관계 여부 등을 모두 살펴본다. 또 선관위 공무원의 국외 출장과 여비 집행, 업무추진비와 특근매식비 집행 실태도 들여다본다. 당선무효자 선거비용 반환채권 관리 실태도 감사 대상이다. 선관위는 선거법 위반 등으로 선거비용을 반환해야 할 후보들에게 약 236억원을 회수하지 못하고 있다.)

However, the BAI stated regarding the ballot paper printing issues, "We will carefully review the timing, scope, and whether to initiate an audit, taking into account the investigations by the joint prosecution and police investigation headquarters and the (National Assembly) parliamentary inquiry." It also plans to check whether previous audit findings from BAI audits, such as the 2022 regular audit of the central NEC, have been properly implemented. (다만 감사원은 투표용지 인쇄 관련 문제는 “검경합동수사본부 수사와 (국회) 국정조사 상황 등을 고려해 감사 착수 여부와 범위, 시기 등을 신중하게 검토해 결정할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 또, 2022년 중앙선관위 정기감사 등 과거 감사원 감사에서 지적받은 사항을 제대로 이행했는지도 들여다볼 계획이다.)

Before commencing the full-scale audit, the BAI began collecting data for an accounting inspection of the NEC on the 23rd of last month and formed an audit team of 42 members, led by the Director General of the Administrative and Safety Audit Bureau. The audit will be conducted in two phases: July (6th to 24th) and August (1st to 14th). The BAI plans to determine the audit targets, key focus areas, and whether to expand the audit team based on the results of the first-phase audit in July before proceeding with the second phase. (감사원은 본격적인 감사 착수에 앞서 지난달 23일부터 선관위 회계 검사를 위한 자료 수집에 들어갔으며, 행정·안전감사국장을 단장으로 42명의 감사반을 편성했다. 감사는 7월(6∼24일)과 8월(1일∼14일) 두 차례에 걸쳐 진행된다. 감사원은 7월 1단계 감사 결과에 따라 감사 대상과 중점 사항, 감사 인력 확대 여부를 결정해 2단계 감사를 실시한다는 계획이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.k)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae: "No Reason to Resign" ... Park Ji-won: "Disappear Quickly" (이병태 “사퇴할 이유 없다”…박지원 “빨리 사라지길”)
item.description:
Lee Byung-tae, deputy head of the Presidential Committee on Regulatory Rationalization, who claimed that the May 18 Democratic Uprising had become a "sanctuary" amid calls for severe punishment of the Seoul Baejae High School baseball team for their "mockery cheer" related to the May 18 movement, has dismissed demands for his resignation. (‘5·18 조롱 응원’을 한 서울 배재고 야구부에 대한 중징계를 두고 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장이 자진사퇴 주장을 일축했다.)

In a phone interview with the Chosun Ilbo on the 5th, Lee argued, "I posted that because I thought the severe punishment of Baejae High School was an undesirable aspect of Korea, but it has been distorted by the political actions of politicians." Stating, "This is a statement based on personal conscience, so my stance will not change," Lee responded to calls for resignation within the ruling party by saying, "It's a two-year term, so I’m not sure on what grounds they’re doing this" and "If the appointing authority (the president) wants, I can resign anytime, but I haven’t received any contact." ( 이 부위원장은 5일 조선일보와 전화 인터뷰에서 “배재고 중징계가 한국의 바람직하지 않은 모습이라고 생각해 올린 글이었는데, 이게 정치인들의 정치 행위들로 인해 변질됐다”고 주장했다. “개인의 양심에 따른 발언이기 때문에, 입장이 바뀔 일은 없다”는 이 부위원장은 여권 내 사퇴 요구에 대해 “2년 임기로 돼 있는데 무슨 근거로 그러는지 잘 모르겠다”며 “임명권자(대통령)가 원하면 언제든지 (사퇴)할 수 있겠지만 연락 온 건 없다”고 말했다. )

In an interview with Yonhap News TV on the same day, Lee also said, "I don’t see any reason for me to resign" and "If I were swayed by being shaken, that would be even more foolish." ( 이 부위원장은 같은 날 연합뉴스티브이(TV)와 인터뷰에서도 “내가 사퇴할 이유가 없지 않나”라며 “흔든다고 흔들리면 그게 더 바보 같은 짓”이라고 말했다. )

Under the Framework Act on Administrative Regulations, members of the Regulatory Rationalization Committee cannot be dismissed or removed against their will except in cases such as "being sentenced to imprisonment without labor or heavier" or "being unable to perform duties due to long-term physical or mental decline." This means there is no way to force Lee out except through his voluntary resignation. ( 행정규제기본법에 따라 규제합리화위원회 위원은 ‘금고 이상의 형을 선고받은 경우’나 ‘장기간의 심신쇠약으로 직무를 수행할 수 없게 된 경우’를 제외하고는 본인의 의사와 관계없이 면직되거나 해촉되지 않는다. 이 부위원장의 자진사퇴 말고는 이 부위원장을 물러나게 할 방법이 없는 셈이다. )

Voices within the ruling party continue to demand Lee's resignation. Park Ji-won, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, criticized in a Facebook post on the 6th, "The Baejae students visiting Gwangju Ilgo and paying respects at the May 18 Democratic Cemetery in repentance is respect for basic rights." He added, "Despite Vice Chairman Lee’s talk of basic rights and the Blue House’s stern warning, he insists he hasn’t heard anything from the president, the appointing authority, and remains unbothered." ( 여권 내에서는 이 부위원장의 자진 사퇴를 요구하는 목소리가 계속되고 있다. 박지원 더불어민주당 의원은 6일 페이스북에 올린 글에서 “배재고 학생들이 광주일고를 방문하고 5·18민주묘역을 참배하겠다고 반성하는 것이 기본권의 존중”이라며 “이 부위원장은 기본권 운운하며 청와대의 엄중한 경고에도 임명권자인 대통령으로부터 아무 소리도 듣지 않았다며 아랑곳하지 않고 버티고 있다”고 비판했다. )

He further wrote, "Is intellectual Lee Byung-tae’s basic rights like Chun Doo-hwan’s? I urge him to resign quickly and, if he can’t even return to the soil like Chun, to pay respects and disappear while dedicating himself to Chun Doo-hwan’s unacceptable basic rights." ( 이어 “지식인 이병태씨의 기본권은 전두환식? 빨리 사퇴하고 흙으로도 못 돌아간 전두환을 참배하며, 천하에 용납 못 할 전두환식 기본권을 바치고 사라질 것을 촉구한다”고 덧붙였다. )

Kim Nam-kook, a Democratic Party lawmaker, also argued in a Facebook post on the same day, "Public office is not a place to freely flaunt personal beliefs" and "He should resign immediately." ( 김남국 민주당 의원도 이날 페이스북 글에서 “공직은 개인의 신념을 마음껏 과시하는 자리가 아니”라며 “즉각 자진사퇴해야 한다”고 주장했다. )

Park Beom-kye, a Democratic Party lawmaker, said on MBC Radio’s "Kim Jong-bae’s Focus" on the same day, "I get the feeling that there might be subsequent reactions, responses, or measures from the Blue House," adding, "This will likely be linked to Professor Lee Byung-tae’s future remarks and actions." ( 박범계 민주당 의원은 이날 문화방송(MBC) 라디오 ‘김종배의 시선집중’에서 “(청와대에서) 추후적인 반응과 대응과 조치가 있지 않을까 하는 그런 느낌도 가져본다”며 “(이는) 이병태 교수의 추후 언동도 연관이 있을 것”이라고도 말했다. )

Earlier, on the 2nd, Lee, who holds a rank equivalent to a prime minister, claimed on Facebook regarding the Baejae High School baseball team punished for a "Starbucks cheering song" mocking the May 18 Democratization Movement that "May 18 has become a sanctuary in this land" and called it "a scene from North Korea." After controversy erupted, he deleted the post, but on the 4th, he reiterated his stance on Facebook, saying, "The core of my opinion is ‘freedom of expression.’" Although the Blue House issued a stern warning on the same day, stating, "As a person in a responsible position within a government-affiliated agency, this is inappropriate conduct," Lee posted again on Facebook on the night of the 5th, arguing, "The correct way to respond to unpleasant language is not the legal sword of regulation and punishment" and "In life, we must learn to consider others, but we should also cultivate a resilience not to be hurt by others’ words." ( 앞서 총리급인 이 부위원장은 지난 2일 페이스북에서 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’로 징계를 받은 배재고 야구부와 관련해 “이 땅에 5·18이 성역이 된 것”, “북한의 모습”이라고 주장했다. 논란이 일자 해당 글을 삭제했지만 4일 페이스북에서 “내 의견의 핵심은 ‘표현의 자유’”라며 기존 입장을 고수했다. 이에 청와대가 같은 날 “정부 소속 기관의 책임 있는 위치의 사람으로서 부적절한 처신”이라며 엄중히 경고했지만 이 부위원장은 5일 밤 페이스북에 또 글을 올려 “불쾌한 언어에 대응하는 올바른 방법은 규제와 징계라는 법적 칼날이 아니다”, “살아가면서 타인에 대한 배려도 배워야 하지만 타인의 말에 상처받지 않는 심지도 키워야 한다”고 주장했다. )

By Jeon Gwang-jun, Reporter light@hani.co.kr ( 전광준 기자 light@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Han Byung-do says of Lee Un-ju 'synthetic porn' damage: "Serious crime... strong legal response" (한병도, 이언주 ‘합성 음란물’ 피해에 “중대 범죄…강력 법적 대응”)
item.description:
Han Byung-do, acting leader and floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th, "The recent distribution of synthetic pornographic material and sexual defamation targeting lawmaker Lee Un-ju is a serious criminal act that destroys a person's dignity," adding, "We will apply a zero-tolerance principle at the central party level and pursue a strong legal response." (한병도 더불어민주당 대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표는 “최근 이언주 의원을 대상으로 자행된 합성 음란물 유포와 성적 모독은 한 인간의 존엄을 말살한 중대한 범죄 행위”라며 “중앙당 차원에서 무관용 원칙을 적용해 강력한 법적 대응에 나서겠다”고 6일 밝혔다.)

At a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Floor Leader Han defined the incident as "not an exercise of freedom of political expression, but blatant violence and character assassination," and said, "What is even more shocking is the fact that secondary harm is occurring, with people laughing at and mocking the victim's suffering and reposting the material." Han added, "We will root out and severely punish these shameless illegal perpetrators, who can never be tolerated for any reason, to ensure such incidents never recur," and urged, "Investigative authorities should also conduct immediate and rigorous investigations to bring both the original creators and those who distributed and shared the material to justice." <<> Lawmaker Song Young-gil also posted on his Facebook that day, criticizing, "Politicians can be criticized and become targets of satire, but the moment someone is reduced to a sexual object and their personality is destroyed, it is not freedom of expression but a crime." Song stated, "It is free to support anyone within our party, but reducing a person to a target of sexual crime and mockery solely for that reason is violence," and added, "Tolerating digital sexual crimes with the attitude that 'it's okay if it's our side,' turning a blind eye and remaining silent, is not neutrality but complicity that fuels the harm." <<> Earlier, the law firm Oreunhaneul, representing Lee Un-ju, issued consecutive press releases on the 3rd and 4th, announcing that they had "initiated legal action against the suspect who produced and posted synthetic pornographic and defamatory content targeting Lee online," and stated, "Secondary harm is continuing, with some online reposting, sharing, quoting, and spreading the material," vowing to hold all possible civil and criminal legal responsibilities. <<> Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (한 원내대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 이 사건을 “정치적 표현의 자유가 아닌 명백한 폭력이자 인격 테러”라고 규정하고, “더 충격적인 것은 피해자의 고통을 비웃고 조롱하며 해당 게시물을 재게시하는 2차 가해까지 펼쳐지고 있다는 사실”이라며 이렇게 밝혔다. 한 원내대표는 “어떤 이유로도 결코 용인될 수 없는 파렴치한 불법 행위자들을 발본색원하고 일벌백계해 다시는 이런 일이 재발하지 않도록 하겠다”며 “수사 당국도 즉각적이고 엄정한 수사를 통해 최초 제작자는 물론이고, 유포·공유자까지 모두 법의 심판대에 세워 달라”고 촉구했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Mega-Projects: "Would Prefer No Obstruction... Are You Statesmen?" (이 대통령 “메가프로젝트, 방해는 안 했으면…공인 맞냐”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th called for a "speed drive" in administrative procedures regarding the "three major mega-projects," stating, "It would be good to proactively secure electricity and water supply issues rather than waiting for other procedures to finish." <<>> Speaking at the "Public-Private Joint Review Meeting on Mega-Projects" held at the Presidential Office that day, President Lee said, "The central government should anticipate and proactively resolve potential obstacles so that businesses can focus on investment and field operations." He added, "Administrative procedures are particularly problematic; there must absolutely be no delays in investment execution due to prolonged administrative processes." Previously, the government announced through the "three major mega-projects" plans to invest 896 trillion won in the Honam region for semiconductor clusters, 392 trillion won in the Chungcheong region for AI data center construction, and 312 trillion won in the Yeongnam region for physical AI and other initiatives. <<>> President Lee noted, "I heard that the Yongin general industrial complex was completed relatively quickly, but it took six years from site confirmation to fab groundbreaking. While it might be considered fast by some, in my view, it doesn't seem so. Delays in compensation could take even more time, so I hope we can prevent such issues." He continued, "Environmental impact assessments are necessary, but if the same area is involved, do we really need to do it again? It's important to leverage existing results, and even if conducted anew, the process should be shortened. If it's something that must be done anyway, rather than wasting time on procedures, I suggest pursuing it in parallel or simultaneously as long as it's not illegal." <<>> He also instructed that the processes of negotiated acquisition and compulsory expropriation for land acquisition should begin simultaneously to expedite the timeline. "If there are land-grabbing issues in the acquisition process, negotiations take a lot of time, and compulsory expropriation starts only at the end. I want you to initiate negotiated acquisition and compulsory expropriation at the same time," President Lee said. <<>> Furthermore, President Lee aimed criticism at the opposition party, stating, "We are trying to create new opportunities for our people, especially struggling young people. Even if you can't cooperate, I hope you won't seriously obstruct the efforts." He added, "They argue for balance based on the premise that a project is feasible, then claim it's deception or a stunt based on the premise that it's impossible. Is it proper for public officials in charge of national affairs to take such an attitude? Pick one: either criticize based on the premise of impossibility, or point out imbalance based on the premise of possibility. Just do one." <<>> Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 6일 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’와 관련해 “전력, 용수 문제도 다른 절차가 끝날 때까지 기다릴 게 아니라 선제적으로 확보하면 좋겠다”며 행정절차 ‘속도전’을 주문했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok declares candidacy for Democratic Party leader… Takes aim at Jung Cheong-rae, saying "Self-centered politics causing party confusion" (김민석, 민주당 대표 출마선언…정청래 겨냥 “자기정치로 당 혼선”)
item.description:
Former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok announced on the 6th, "I declare my candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party with an infinite sense of responsibility for the success of the Lee Jae-myung administration." This is the first official declaration among the candidates for the party leader position in the August 17 national convention. (김민석 전 국무총리가 6일 “이재명 정부 국정 성공에 대한 무한한 책임감으로 민주당 대표 출마를 선언한다”고 밝혔다. 8·17 전당대회 당대표 주자 중 첫 공식 출마 선언이다.)

In a statement at Jeonil Building 245 in Dong-gu, Gwangju-Jeonnam Integrated Special City, the former Prime Minister Kim said, "My decision to run for party leader is the product of a heavy sense of responsibility, prepared for intense internal party debate for the party's future. The top priority for the success of the absolute task—the Lee Jae-myung administration—is to achieve innovation within the ruling Democratic Party," declaring his candidacy. (김 전 총리는 이날 전남광주통합특별시 동구 전일빌딩245에서 “저의 당 대표 선거 출마는 당의 미래를 위해 치열한 당내 논쟁 각오한 무거운 책임감 산물이다. 절대 과제인 이재명 정부 성공을 위한 최우선 과제는 집권당인 민주당의 혁신 이뤄내는 것”이라며 당 대표 출마를 선언했다.)

Kim added, "Over the past year, the Democratic Party has failed to translate public support for the president and government into party backing and election results. The harm of self-centered politics over the past year has plunged the party and party-government cooperation into confusion," and warned, "At this rate, it will be difficult to achieve government success, win general elections, or maintain party unity." This is interpreted as a jab at former party leader Jung Cheong-rae. (김 전 총리는 “(민주당은) 지난 1년간 대통령과 정부에 대한 국정 지지를 정당 지지와 선거 결과로 연결하지 못했다. 지난 1년, 자기정치의 폐해가 당과 당정 협력을 혼선에 빠뜨렸다”며 “이대로는 국정 성공도 총선 승리도 당의 단합도 어렵다”고도 했다. 정청래 전 대표를 겨냥한 말로 해석된다.)

Kim also stated, "I am deeply grateful to President Kim Dae-jung, who taught me politics; President Roh Moo-hyun, who opened the door for my return by calling the merger with Jeong Mong-joon's National Unity 21 'a rational and passionate move' ahead of the 2002 presidential election; President Moon Jae-in, who restored the Democratic Party flag I upheld; and President Lee Jae-myung, who has made me a partner in state affairs. I will carry on their spirit and legacy as a party member." (김 전 총리는 “제게 정치를 가르쳐주신 김대중 대통령님, (2002년 대선을 앞두고 정몽준 국민통합21 후보와) ‘단일화는 합리적 충정이었다’라며 복귀의 문을 열어주신 노무현 대통령님, 제가 지킨 민주당 깃발을 복권해주신 문재인 대통령님, 국정의 파트너로 삼아주신 이재명 대통령님, 네 분 모두에게 깊이 감사드리고 당인으로서 그 정신과 역사를 이어가겠다”고도 했다.)

Before his announcement, former Prime Minister Kim visited the May 18th National Cemetery. There, he laid flowers and offered incense at the memorial tower before visiting the graves of activist martyrs Yoon Sang-won and Park Hyun-sook. In the guestbook, he wrote, "Now, May 18th is not just history but the future" and "Kim Min-seok, candidate for Democratic Party leader." (김 전 총리는 출마 선언에 앞서 이날 국립5·18민주묘지를 참배했다. 이 자리에서 김 전 총리는 민주묘지 추모탑에서 헌화·분향한 뒤 윤상원·박현숙 열사 묘소를 찾아 참배했다. 방명록에는 ‘이제 5·18이 역사를 넘어 미래입니다’ ‘민주당 당대표 후보 김민석’이라고 적었다.)

Choi Ha-yan reporter chy@hani.co.kr Jeong Hye-min reporter jhm@hani.co.kr (최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr 정혜민 기자 jhm@hani.co.kr)

item.title: DP, Innovation, and Social Democrats in National Assembly's Policy Committee: "We Need to Hold Homeplus Hearings" (국회 정무위서 민주·혁신·사민 “홈플러스 청문회 열어야”)
item.description:
Lawmakers affiliated with the Democratic Party of Korea (DP), the Rebuilding Korea Party (Innovation Party), and the Social Democratic Party, who serve on the National Assembly's Policy Affairs Committee, demanded on the 6th during the first plenary session of the second half of the term that hearings be held regarding Homeplus, which faces bankruptcy following a decision to terminate its corporate rehabilitation procedures. <<> DP lawmaker Min Byeong-deok requested a point of order during the Policy Committee plenary session, stating, "On the 3rd, the Seoul Rehabilitation Court decided to terminate Homeplus's rehabilitation procedures due to the failure of its largest shareholder, MBK Partners, and creditor Meritz Financial to secure 200 billion won in new funds." He added, "I strongly urge the Policy Committee to push for hearings on the Homeplus situation to protect the livelihoods of the 100,000 workers (including Homeplus employees, partners, and suppliers) and their families, and to hold financial authorities strictly accountable for their oversight responsibilities." <<> Min further stated, "MBK, which has recovered over 5 trillion won in cash over the past 10 years through dividends and asset sales, has remained silent on funding for rehabilitation and Chairman Kim Byung-ju's personal guarantees. Meritz Financial, as the largest creditor, has also shirked its social responsibility and engaged in predatory financial practices." He added, "This is a typical livelihood disaster caused by a predatory private equity fund that acquires companies with heavy debt, strips them of value, and then flees." <<> DP lawmaker Park Hong-bae also stated, "A hearing is essential to investigate the process of MBK Partners' acquisition of Homeplus and the various issues that have arisen since." DP lawmaker Lee Kang-il remarked, "If the main opposition party does not cooperate in organizing the committees, it may be difficult to schedule hearings. There is a risk of missing the right time, so for matters related to livelihoods, we should hold hearings even if we have to do it on our own." This suggests that even if the People Power Party does not engage in bipartisan consultation on the seven standing committees where chairpersons have yet to be decided in the second half of the 22nd National Assembly, the DP should lead the effort to hold hearings. <<> Minority opposition lawmakers attending the Policy Committee also demanded hearings. Rebuilding Korea Party lawmaker Lee Hae-min said, "If we combine our numbers here, we have three parties (DP, Innovation Party, Social Democratic Party), so I believe we can hold bipartisan hearings." Social Democratic Party lawmaker Han Chang-min also stated, "I hope our standing committee will actively hold hearings to uncover and hold accountable MBK and Meritz Securities' irresponsibility." <<> DP-affiliated Policy Committee Chair Yoo Dong-soo said during the meeting, "Once the opposition party's Policy Committee secretary is appointed, we will proceed with holding hearings through consultation between the secretaries." On this day, the Policy Committee appointed DP lawmaker Park Sang-hyeok, serving his second term, as the ruling party's Policy Committee secretary. <<> Reporter Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (더불어민주당과 조국혁신당, 사회민주당 소속 국회 정무위원회 위원들이 6일 후반기 첫 전체회의에서 기업회생절차 폐지 결정으로 파산 위기에 놓인 홈플러스에 대해 청문회를 열자고 요구했다.)

item.title: Democracy Party: "Lee Jin-sook Sent a Wreath to Baejae High School in an Immature Manner... Students Are the Mature Ones" (민주 “이진숙, 미숙하게 배재고에 화환…학생들이 성숙”)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea criticized People Power Party lawmaker Lee Jin-sook for sending a supportive wreath to Seoul's Baejae High School, calling it "highly inappropriate and an act that casts doubt on even the most basic sense of history." (이진숙 국민의힘 의원이 서울 배재고에 응원 화환을 보낸 것을 두고 더불어민주당은 “매우 부적절하며, 최소한의 역사의식마저 의심케 하는 처사”라고 비판했다.)

Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi stated in a written briefing on the 6th, "The students apologized in a mature manner, while the lawmaker sent a wreath in an immature way." (박경미 민주당 대변인은 6일 서면브리핑에서 “학생들은 성숙하게 사죄했고 국회의원은 미숙하게 화환을 보냈다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Previously, on the 29th of last month, baseball players from Baejae High School sang a 'Starbucks cheer song' mocking the May 18 Democratic Uprising directed at players from Gwangju Jeil High School during the 81st Blue Dragon National High School Baseball Tournament. On the 1st, they received a heavy disciplinary measure of a 'six-month ban from national tournaments' from the Korea Baseball Softball Association (KBSA). (앞서 배재고 야구부 선수들은 지난달 29일 제81회 청룡기 전국고교야구대회에서 광주제일고(광주일고) 선수들을 향해 5·18민주화운동을 조롱하는 ‘스타벅스 응원가’를 불렀다가 지난 1일 대한야구소프트볼협회(KBSA)로부터 ‘6개월 전국대회 출전 정지’라는 중징계를 받았다.)

Around 80 individuals, including Baejae High School baseball players, coaches, parents, and staff, were scheduled to visit Gwangju Jeil High School to apologize and jointly pay respects at the May 18 Democratic Cemetery on the afternoon of that day. However, a day before on the 5th, a controversy erupted when it was revealed that lawmaker Lee had sent a wreath to Baejae High School bearing the phrases, "What does Starbucks have to do with May 18?" and "We stand with the Baejae High School students." (배재고 야구부 선수들과 지도자, 학부모, 교직원 등 80여명은 이날 오후 광주일고를 사과 방문하고 5·18 민주묘지를 함께 참배할 예정인데 이를 하루 앞둔 5일 이 의원이 “스타벅스가 5·18과 무슨 관계가 있나”, “배재고 학생들과 함께 합니다”라는 글귀가 적힌 화환을 배재고에 보냈다고 밝히면서 논란이 일었다.)

Spokesperson Park assessed, "The inappropriate cheer chant by Baejae High School's baseball team was a mistake that cannot be taken lightly," but added, "Fortunately, the power of education and the spirit of solidarity are still alive." She continued, "I express my respect for the courage of Baejae High School, which acknowledged its wrongdoing and took a responsible stance to apologize, and for the包容 of the Gwangju Jeil High School community, which accepted this with a generous heart." (박 대변인은 “배재고 야구부의 부적절한 응원 구호는 결코 가벼이 넘길 수 없는 과오”라면서도 “다행히 교육의 힘과 연대의 정신은 살아 있었다”고 평가했다. 이어 “잘못을 인정하고 책임 있는 자세로 사죄에 나선 배재고의 용기와, 이를 너른 마음으로 받아들인 광주일고 공동체의 포용에 경의를 표한다”고 덧붙였다.)

However, she expressed strong regret over the lawmaker's act of sending a wreath. Park stated, "Even though an educational resolution process for the Baejae High School incident is proceeding calmly, some within the People Power Party are trying to turn it into a subject of political strife." She criticized, "In particular, the action of a certain lawmaker from the People Power Party to send a supportive wreath to Baejae High School is highly inappropriate and an act that casts doubt on even the most basic sense of history." Park added, "I express strong regret over whether a lawmaker, who has a responsibility to mediate conflicts and heal wounds, might be using the Baejae High School incident as a spark to rally their support base." (반면 이 의원이 화환을 보낸 것을 두고는 강한 유감을 표했다. 박 대변인은 “배재고 사태에 대한 교육적 해결 절차가 차분히 진행 중임에도, 국민의힘 일각에서는 이를 정쟁의 소재로 삼으려 하고 있다”며 “특히 국민의힘의 모 의원이 배재고에 응원 화환을 보낸 행동은 매우 부적절하며, 최소한의 역사의식마저 의심케 하는 처사”라고 비판했다. 박 대변인은 “갈등을 중재하고 상처를 치유해야 할 책임이 있는 국회의원이, 배재고 사태를 지지층 결집의 불씨로 삼고 있는 것은 아닌지 강한 유감을 표한다”고 밝혔다.)

Park further noted, "What a politician representing the people should do is not send a wreath to fan the flames of factional fights, but to observe and provide solid support so that this incident can become a valuable opportunity for students to learn about the noble values of democracy and the attitude of mutual respect." She concluded, "I hope the People Power Party will look at the mature steps of these children with shame and engage in self-reflection." (박 대변인은 “국민을 대표하는 정치인이 해야 할 일은 화환을 보내 진영 싸움을 부추기는 것이 아니라, 이번 사태가 학생들에게 민주주의의 숭고한 가치와 상호 존중의 태도를 배우는 소중한 계기가 될 수 있도록 지켜보고 든든히 지원하는 일”이라며 “국민의힘은 아이들의 성숙한 발걸음을 부끄러운 눈으로 바라보며 자성하기 바란다”고 덧붙였다.)
