item.title: PPP Wearing Black Masks Calls New ICT Act on 'Punitive Damages' a 'Gag Law' (검은 마스크 쓴 국힘, ‘징벌적 손배’ 새 정보통신망법에 “입틀막법”)
item.description:
On the 6th, a day before the revised Information and Communications Network Act takes effect, the People Power Party (PPP) launched a full-scale offensive, labeling the law an 'Online Gag Law.' (국민의힘이 개정 정보통신망법 시행을 하루 앞둔 6일 해당 법에 대해 ‘온라인 입틀막법’이라고 규정하며 총공세에 나섰다.)

PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that morning, "Starting tomorrow, the revised Information and Communications Network Act, the so-called 'Gag Law,' comes into effect," adding, "(The revised law) is about shutting down not only the existing legacy media but also the mouths of YouTubers, just before the cancellation of a prosecution." Party leadership, including Chairman Jang and the floor leader, attended the Supreme Council meeting wearing black masks to signify their intention to highlight the unfairness of the revised Information and Communications Network Act. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 오전 열린 국회 최고위원회의에서 “내일부터 개정 정보통신망법, 소위 ‘입틀막법’이 시행된다”며 “(개정 정보통신망법은) 공소취소를 앞두고 기존의 레거시 언론은 물론, 유튜버들의 입까지 모두 틀어막겠다는 것”이라고 했다. 장 대표와 원내대표를 비롯한 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 개정 정보통신망법의 부당함을 알리겠다는 의미로 검은색 마스크를 착용한 채 최고위원회의에 참석했다.)

Chairman Jang emphasized, "If you blind the people, cover their ears, and shut their mouths, the end result is the completion of Lee Jae-myung's dictatorship," and "It reminds me of Hong Kong, where anti-China media closed their doors and were sent to prison. The PPP will revise the Information and Communications Network Act again to protect the people's freedom." (장 대표는 “국민의 눈을 가리고 귀를 막고 입까지 틀어막으면 끝은 바로 이재명 독재의 완성”이라며 “반중 언론의 문을 닫고 감옥에 보낸 홍콩의 모습이 떠오른다. 국민의힘은 정보통신망법을 다시 개정해 국민의 자유를 지킬 것”이라고 강조했다.)

Floor leader Jeong also stated, "The online gag law forces large-scale online platform operators to delete, block, and prevent the distribution of such information," adding, "Platforms will carry out prior censorship, keeping an eye on the authorities, and users will be trapped in self-censorship out of fear of lawsuits and complaints." He urged the Democratic Party, "Suspend the enforcement immediately and begin discussions to revise the act to remove its toxic clauses." (정 원내대표도 “온라인 입틀막법은 대규모 온라인 플랫폼 사업자에 해당 정보의 삭제, 차단 및 유통 방지 업무를 강제한다”며 “플랫폼은 권력의 눈치를 보면서 사전 검열을 할 것이고 이용자는 고소·고발이 두려워 자기 검열에 갇히게 될 것”이라고 말했다. 민주당을 향해 “시행을 즉시 유예하고 독소 조항 삭제를 위한 재개정 논의에 착수하자”고 했다.)

Shin Dong-wook, a Supreme Council member and former journalist, also claimed, "Today is the last day of guaranteed press freedom in South Korea," arguing, "It's about shutting down criticism from YouTubers, online dissent, and opposition party critiques against President Lee Jae-myung." He added, "They plan to have an agency under the Broadcasting Media and Communications Commission judge fake news," further stating, "Delegating judgment to a government-controlled body is itself unconstitutional and a serious setback for democracy." (언론인 출신인 신동욱 최고위원도 “오늘은 대한민국 언론 자유가 보장되는 마지막 날”이라면서 “이재명 대통령에 대한 유튜버들과 온라인상의 비판, 국민적 저항, 야당의 비판을 틀어막겠다는 것”이라고 주장했다. 이어 “가짜뉴스 판단을 방송미디어통신위원회 산하 기구에서 하겠다는 것”이라며 “정부가 통제할 수 있는 기관에 판단을 맡긴다는 것 자체로 이미 위헌이고 민주주의의 심각한 후퇴”라고 덧붙였다.)

In response to the PPP's offensive, the Democratic Party countered, calling it "distortion." Democratic Party spokesperson Park Kyung-mi emphasized to the PPP, "For those of us who have witnessed a reality where lives are lost for the sake of cyber wreckers' view counts, what we need now is not the freedom of manipulation forces, but the safety of the people," stressing that the revised Information and Communications Network Act is a law to prevent harm from false and manipulated information. (국민의힘의 공세에 더불어민주당은 “왜곡”이라고 반박했다. 박경미 민주당 대변인은 국민의힘을 향해 “사이버 렉카의 조회수 장사에 목숨까지 잃는 현실을 지켜본 우리에게 지금 필요한 것은 조작 세력의 자유가 아니라 국민의 안전이다”며 개정 정보통신망법이 허위조작정보의 피해를 막는 법이라고 강조했다.)

Starting on the 7th, under the revised Information and Communications Network Act, punitive damages of up to five times the amount of harm will be imposed for the intentional distribution of false and manipulated information online. False and manipulated information will be judged by 'fact-checking organizations' supported by the Transparency Center, which is under the Broadcasting Media and Communications Commission. (개정 정보통신망법에 따라 7일부터 온라인상 허위조작정보를 고의로 유통할 경우 손해액의 최대 5배까지 징벌적 손해배상이 부과된다. 허위조작정보는 방송미디어통신위원회 산하 투명성센터의 지원을 받는 ‘사실확인단체’가 판단한다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr 조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Rejects 'Third-Party Recommendation' for Election Commission Special Investigation, Demanding 'Opposition Recommendation' and 'Unlimited Scope' (국힘, 선관위 특검 ‘제3자 추천안’ 거부…“야당 추천·수사 범위 무제한”)
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) on the 6th rejected the Democratic Party's proposal for a special investigation into the National Election Commission (NEC) through a 'third-party recommendation' method, reiterating its demand for an 'opposition recommendation' approach. PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, "The special investigation the people want is one with opposition recommendation and an unlimited scope of investigation," adding, "Only then can the people trust the investigation results. Immediately accept a proper people's special investigation." He continued, "(The Democratic Party) says it will limit the scope of the investigation to the current situation and within the NEC," and noted, "It has even been revealed that on election day, Democratic Party lawmaker Seo Young-gyo and former NEC chair Noh Tae-ak had a phone call. To uncover all the truth from the past and uproot the election cartel, limiting the scope of the investigation is simply absurd." He further stated, "If they hold out with a 'bed special investigation,' it will only speed up the collapse of the regime." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also said, "The targets of the special investigation must inevitably include not only the NEC but also the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, which oversees election support tasks. The primary target of the special investigation will be acting NEC Chair Wi Cheol-hwan, the 'president's rice friend,'" adding, "Under the principle of excluding interested parties, the Democratic Party's right to recommend should naturally be excluded." He further argued, "The Democratic Party suddenly brought up a third-party recommendation from the Korean Bar Association, but since the acting chair is a former head of the Korean Bar Association, this too is unacceptable," and dismissed, "Given that Supreme Court justice Noh Tae-ak concurrently served as NEC chair and that incumbent judges also simultaneously serve as chairs of city, provincial, and district election commissions, the Supreme Court recommendation method is also not worth considering." <<> Earlier, on the previous day, Democratic Party acting leader and floor leader Han Byung-do stated on Facebook, "The People Power Party is spouting sophistry that the Democratic Party should be excluded from the process of recommending the NEC special investigation. A third-party recommendation method for appointing the special investigation would be more realistic and fair." The Democratic Party plans to submit the NEC special investigation bill this week. <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung: sea@hani.co.kr (국민의힘이 6일 더불어민주당의 ‘제3자 추천' 방식 선거관리위원회(선관위) 특검 제안을 거부하며 ‘야당 추천’ 방식을 거듭 요구했다. 장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 최고위원회의에서 “국민이 바라는 특검은 야당 추천, 수사 범위 무제한”이라며 “그래야 국민이 수사 결과를 믿을 수 있다. 즉각 제대로 된 국민 특검을 수용하라”고 말했다. 이어 “(민주당은) 수사 범위도 이번 사태와 선관위 내부로 제한하겠다고 한다”며 “선거 당일 서영교 민주당 의원과 노태악 전 중앙선거관리위원장이 통화한 사실까지 드러났는데, 과거로부터의 모든 진상을 규명하고 선거 카르텔까지 뿌리 뽑으려면 수사 범위 제한이야말로 어불성설”이라고 말했다. 그러면서 “‘침대 특검’으로 버틴다면 결국 정권 몰락의 속도만 높아질 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: [Breaking] Blue House recommends resignation of Lee Byung-tae, who called May 18 "sacrosanct"... "Matter is very serious" ([속보] 청와대, “5·18 성역” 이병태 사퇴 권고…“사안 매우 엄중”)
item.description:
On the 6th, the Blue House recommended that Lee Byung-tae, vice chairman of the Regulatory Reform Committee under the direct control of the president, who claimed that "May 18 has become a sacrosanct area," resign. (청와대가 6일 “5·18이 성역이 됐다”고 주장한 이병태 대통령 직속 규제합리화위원회 부위원장에게 사퇴를 권고했다.)

The Blue House issued a statement that afternoon, saying, "The Blue House emphasized and implemented a warning measure, stressing that as a key member appointed to a presidential committee with significant responsibilities and authority, one must strive to align with the government's policy direction." It added, "Subsequently, due to the matter being very serious, we recommended the resignation of Vice Chairman Lee." (청와대는 이날 오후 입장을 내고 “청와대는 책임과 권한이 큰 대통령 직속 위원회에 임명된 주요 구성원으로서 정부의 국정 기조에 부합하기 위해 노력해야 함을 강조하고 경고 조치를 시행했다”며 “이후 사안이 매우 엄중한 까닭에 이 부위원장의 사퇴를 권고했다”고 말했다.)

The Blue House further stated, "Accordingly, Vice Chairman Lee is currently determining his own position," and added, "The Lee Jae-myung administration will continue its efforts to expand inclusivity beyond the divide between conservatives and progressives." (청와대는 이어 “이에 현재 이 부위원장이 스스로 거취를 판단하는 중”이라며 “이재명 정부는 보수와 진보를 넘어 외연을 확장하는 포용의 노력을 지속해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party: "No Plans to Handle Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Rights After Party Convention" (민주 “검찰 보완수사권, 전당대회 이후 처리할 계획은 없어”)
item.description:
Kim Han-gyu, Deputy Chief of the Policy Coordination Office for the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 6th regarding the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, "There are significant differences within the party, so it is not a situation where we need to resume debate," and added, "There are no plans to handle it after the (August 17) party convention." (김한규 더불어민주당 원내정책수석부대표가 6일 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지 여부와 관련해 “당내 이견이 커서 논쟁을 다시 해야 할 상황은 아니다”라며 “(8·17) 전당대회 이후 처리할 계획은 없다”고 밝혔다.)

Meeting with reporters at the National Assembly on the same day, Deputy Chief Kim said about the direction of amending the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes whether to abolish the supplementary investigation rights for prosecutors belonging to the Prosecution Service set to launch in October, "We have no intention of keeping it in mind for the party convention and letting the next leader decide it later for political reasons. It seems better to handle it before that." ( 김 수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 기자들을 만나, 오는 10월 출범할 공소청 소속 검사의 보완수사권 폐지 여부를 담은 형사소송법 개정 방향에 대해 “전당대회를 염두에 두고 정무적으로 그 후에 다음 대표가 결정하게 할 생각은 전혀 없다. 그 전에 처리하는 게 나을 것 같다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

Deputy Chief Kim stated, "Many party members, supporters, and lawmakers are of the position that supplementary investigation rights should be abolished. We have already clearly stated party policy on abolishing supplementary investigation rights." He added, "There are still some who argue that exceptional supplementary investigation rights are necessary, but that is a minority." He continued, "Discussions are focused on how to prepare good supplementary measures for concerns that may arise (if supplementary investigation rights are abolished), not on whether to abolish them now or not." ( 김 수석부대표는 “당원·지지자·의원들 상당수는 보완수사권을 폐지해야 한다는 입장이다. 이미 당론으로 보완수사권 폐지를 명확히 얘기한 적이 있다”며 “그 이후 여전히 예외적 보완수사권이 필요하다고 주장하는 분들이 있긴 하지만 일부분”이라고 했다. 이어 “(보완수사권 폐지 시) 발생할 수 있는 우려에 대해 어떻게 보완책을 잘 마련할 것인가에 대해 논의가 집중되고 있지, 폐지를 지금 하느냐 마냐를 논의할 사안은 아니다”라고 했다.)

The Democratic Party plans to initiate a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that includes the direction of abolishing supplementary investigation rights through a 'Criminal Procedure Act Revision Task Force (TF)' formed around the party's parliamentary leadership (Deputy Chief Kim), the policy committee (Deputy Speaker for Social Affairs Park Sang-hyuk), the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee (Secretary Kim Seung-won), and the Public Administration and Security Committee (Secretary Lee Hae-sik). After the proposal, it will undergo review by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee along with other previously proposed amendments. Earlier, Seo Young-gyo, the chairperson of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee from the Democratic Party, announced that she would table the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act this week and begin review by a subcommittee. ( 민주당은 당 원내지도부(김 수석부대표)와 정책위(박상혁 사회수석부의장), 국회 법제사법위원회(김승원 간사)와 행정안전위원회(이해식 간사)를 중심으로 꾸려진 ‘형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)’에서 보완수사권 폐지 방향을 담은 형사소송법 개정안을 발의한 뒤, 기존 발의된 다른 개정안들과 함께 법사위 심사를 거치도록 할 예정이다. 앞서 민주당 소속의 서영교 법사위원장은 이번 주 안으로 형사소송법 개정안을 상정해 소위원회 심사를 시작하겠다고 밝혔다. )

item.title: President Lee: "Our region was left out, it's impossible... I hope you will not interfere like this" (이 대통령 “우리 지역 빠졌다, 불가능하다…이런 방해 않으셨으면”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung on the 6th directly criticized the conservative opposition for opposing the "Three Major Mega Projects," saying, "Is this really the proper attitude for public officials in charge of national affairs?" (이재명 대통령이 6일 ‘3대 메가프로젝트’를 비판하는 보수 야권을 향해 “나라 살림을 맡은 공인들이 과연 이런 태도를 취하는 게 맞느냐”고 직격했다.)

During his opening remarks at a public-private joint review meeting on the mega projects held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that day, President Lee stated, "Some people, assuming the projects are feasible, first protest by saying, 'Why is our region left out?' but then with the same mouth claim it's a 'scam' or 'impossible.' This is incomprehensible." He added, "I wish they would either criticize based on the premise that the projects are impossible, or point out the imbalance assuming they are possible—just pick one." He continued, "I hope they will not interfere like this," and reiterated, "We are trying to create new opportunities for the Republic of Korea, its people, and struggling youth—please at least refrain from major obstruction, even if you can't fully cooperate." <<> President Lee's remarks are seen as targeting the conservative opposition's criticism—following the announcement of the mega projects on the 29th of last month—that the plan amounts to "catering to specific regions" and lacks "feasibility." The People Power Party (PPP) has argued, regarding the core of the projects, the creation of a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, that "the government is giving the 'core kernel' of a semiconductor fab to Honam while tossing minor 'sesame seed' tasks to regions like Yeongnam and Chungcheong to pretend this is 'coexistence and balanced development'" (Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon). They have also called for "an immediate halt to the behavior of misleading public opinion with a hollow fireworks show called a mega project with no substance" (Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon). <<> The PPP immediately pushed back. Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook that day, saying, "Regarding former President Yoon Seok-yeol's 'Great Whale' project, Lee Jae-myung called it 'a project likely to fail nine times out of ten.' Now he says not to criticize his so-called 'mega project'? He says we can't call it impossible—but was it okay to call the Great Whale project 'nine times out of ten a failure'?" <<> The PPP also took a sharp stance the previous day when the Democratic Party, the government, and Cheong Wa Dae announced plans to create a "Future Response Fund," using additional tax revenue from the semiconductor industry boom as investment resources for future generations. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon stated in a commentary that day, "The essence is nothing more than a 'Power Response Fund' or 'Election Response Fund' aimed at the next party leadership race and general election," and called it "a declaration to use national finances like the regime's pocket money, forcibly pushing a semiconductor cluster into the Honam region, which lacks both power and water." <<> By Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr and Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의 머리발언에서 “일부에서는 (프로젝트의 실현이) 가능하다는 것을 전제로 ‘왜 우리 지역은 빠졌나’라고 항의를 하더니 같은 입으로 ‘사기다’, ‘불가능한 일’이라고 주장을 한다. 이해가 안 된다”며 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “(메가프로젝트가) 불가능하다는 것을 전제로 비난을 하든지, 가능하다는 전제로 불균형을 지적하든지 둘 중 하나만 하면 좋겠다”라며 “이런 식으로 방해하지 않으셨으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 이어 “대한민국, 국민들, 또 어려운 청년들에게 새로운 기회를 만들려고 하는데 최대한 협조는 못 하더라도 크게 방해는 안 했으면 좋겠다”고 거듭 말했다.)

item.title: Ministry of National Defense Suddenly Postpones Announcement of Plan for 'Integrated Army, Navy, Air Force' National Military Academy (국방부, ‘육·해·공 통합’ 국군사관학교 계획 발표 돌연 연기)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense on the 6th abruptly postponed the announcement of the basic plan to establish a unified National Military Academy integrating the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies. (국방부가 6일 육·해·공군 사관학교를 통합한 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표하려다 갑자기 연기했다.)

The ministry had originally scheduled Minister Ahn Gyu-baek to announce the basic plan for the National Military Academy at 10:30 a.m. that day at the ministry building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, but notified reporters around 9 a.m. of a "postponement." (국방부는 애초 이날 오전 10시30분 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 안규백 장관이 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표할 예정이었으나, 이날 오전 9시께 “순연”을 출입기자들에게 공지했다.)

According to the ministry, the postponement was inevitable because Minister Ahn had to attend a public-private joint review meeting for mega-projects held at the presidential office Cheong Wa Dae that morning. It is known that Cheong Wa Dae requested Minister Ahn's attendance at the review meeting. (안 장관이 이날 오전 청와대에서 열리는 메가프로젝트 민관합동 점검회의에 참석하게 되면서 연기할 수밖에 없게 됐다는 게 국방부 설명이다. 청와대가 안 장관의 점검회의 참석을 요청한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Earlier, at around 4 p.m. on the 5th, the ministry had notified the press corps covering it of a "briefing on the basic plan for the National Military Academy's establishment at 10:30 a.m. on the 6th." (앞서 국방부는 지난 5일 오후 4시께 ‘6일 오전 10시30분 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획 브리핑을 한다’고 국방부 출입기자단에게 공지했다.)

Within the ministry, there is talk that the cancellation of the briefing stemmed from concerns about provoking opposition to the integration. The alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies plan to hold a mass rally against the merger in front of the National Assembly on the 8th. (이날 브리핑 취소를 두고 통합 반대 쪽을 자극할 것을 우려했다는 이야기도 국방부 내부에서 나온다. 육·해·공군사관학교 총동창회는 오는 8일 국회 앞에서 사관학교 통합 반대 총궐기대회를 개최할 예정이다.)

It is reported that after Minister Ahn accompanies President Lee Jae-myung, who is attending the NATO summit in Ankara, Turkey, on the 7th and 8th, the ministry plans to reschedule the briefing on the National Military Academy's establishment. (국방부는 안 장관이 7~8일 튀르키예 앙카라에서 열리는 북대서양조약기구(NATO·나토) 정상회의에 참석하는 이재명 대통령을 수행한 이후 국군사관학교 창설 브리핑 일정을 다시 잡을 계획인 것으로 전해졌다.)

The ministry is pursuing the creation of a National Military Academy to strengthen the joint operational capability of the forces, suitable for modern warfare, by integrating the selection of cadets for the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies. The plan involves providing common education for first and second-year students and allowing third and fourth-year students to choose a service branch for specialized education. (국방부는 현대전에 맞는 군의 합동성 강화 등을 위해 국군사관학교를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 방안을 추진 중이다. 1·2학년엔 함께 공통 교육을, 3·4학년엔 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다.)

The ministry commissioned the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA) with a research project on reorganizing the military academies but has not disclosed the results. Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said at a regular briefing that day, "We will announce the basic plan for the National Military Academy soon and hold public hearings and policy briefings. At that time, we plan to release various details, including the research results, and gather opinions." (국방부는 한국국방연구원(KIDA)에 사관학교 개편 연구용역을 맡겼지만 결과를 공개하지 않고 있다. 정빛나 국방부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 “조만간 국군사관학교 창설 기본계획을 발표하고, 공청회와 정책설명회를 추진할 것”이라며 “이때 연구용역 결과를 포함해 다양한 내용을 공개하고 의견을 수렴할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyeok-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Byung-tae, who incited hatred toward the May 18 Democratization Movement, resigns amid "unfair political pressure" (5·18 혐오 조장 이병태 “부당한 정치 공세 밀려 사임”)
